heater delight.name: Heater Delight
heater delight.origin: Heater Delight was an alien who fell victim to slavery and was sold to the Procurer Pro-Boscis as one of his many prostitutes. Due to Pro-Boscis confining her with a bracelet, she became a commodity in his Pleasure Cruiser. She tried to contact her ex-lover Starfox to help her free herself, but fearing for his safety Heater decided to recruit someone more disposable instead. She encountered Pip the Troll on Sirius X whom she manipulated into helping to free her from slavery, promising him some unimaginable pleasure experience. He managed to cut the cable holding her, but it triggered an alarm that caused Pro-Boscis to teleport to their location. Pip managed to defeat the Procurer, only for Starfox to arrive afterwards and ran off with Heater, leaving Pip in charge of the cruiser. After she and Eros parted ways, Heater developed a small business and eventually entered a relationship with the Mystery Planet's monarch Black Roger. When Roger proposed to make a "hundred year contract" with her, she tried to refuse. Seeing that Roger wouldn't take "no" for an answer, she fled and fell back into slavery, this time by Aaron the Aakon who gave her to Axel of the Rescorlans. Starfox again came to her rescue, driving Axel into a frenzy through haggling, allowing him to buy Heater at a much lower prize. Just as they were about to leave, the Rescorlan realized what was going on and sent his people after the couple, forcing Starfox to carry Heater to his father's ship before immediately taking off. Heater and Eros traveled together through space, until they crashed into another disabled ship. She accompanied Starfox in his investigation of the ship, discovering it was named the Principle of Reasonable Interest. Inside they were met by the last surviving crew member Aalbort who told them that the Principle had been attacked by Azunbulxibar and his forces. Aalbort elaborated that his crew had sacrificed themselves to trap Azunbulxibar's army inside a portal seal with meteor shield forcefields, but the attackers were now coming back. Eros helped with the situation by defeating Azunbulxibar and his army, earning him praise by Heater. Eros brought Heater to the commercial center Kotzwinkle where he bought her an extremely valuable bracelet, before going to Checker Lounge III. At the club Eros met with an old friend of his by the name of Howlin' Wolf, but their conversation was soon interrupted by the arrival of Heater's ex, Dark Roger. He had tracked her down for the purpose of proposing to her again, and upon reuniting with Heater he activated a device that engulfed the entire room they were in sparkling lights. She again refused, as despite liking him she didn't want to settle down, leading to Roger revealing that his device had actually teleported the club to his homeworld's Caverns of Silence. He intended to keep her here until she changed her mind, and growing angry over being interrupted Starfox and Howlin' Wolf attacked Roger and his men. While Starfox used the device to return the club to Kotzwinkle, Heater rewarded Howlin' Wolf with a kiss. Again separated from Starfox, Heater was kidnapped by Annihilus and Blastaar to blackmail Pip into bringing them the Hulk. Upon doing so, Pip was reunited with Heater and immediately teleported her to Starlin's Bar in Knowhere. She inquired Pip on why he brought her to such a slummy place, to which he explained that he had spent most of his money trying to save her and as he planned to rescue the Hulk he came to the conclusion that he should bring in Thanos, though she wasn't sure it was a good idea. Assuring her he would be fine, Pip teleported away, leaving Heater all alone in the bar. There she took interest in Quasar and the two immediately hit it off before leaving the bar together.
abilities: Master Seductress: Heater is an expert in enticing and mesmerizing any men she encountered, allowing her to easily manipulate them as she wished.

fields.notes: Heater's appearance has varied over the years. Originally, and more recently, she had blue skin and a tail, but at other times she has been depicted as a blonde humanoid female. When first seen in 1976, Heater had blue skin, brown hair, and a tail. In her next appearance in 1989, she was depicted as a blonde-haired and blue-eyed Caucasian woman. In the next few appearances (all between 1989 and 1990), she remained blonde but her skin was variously depicted as either typical for Caucasian humans or dark pink. In her return in 2015, she was depicted with blue skin again. Some online sources speculate that she has minor shape-shifting abilities.
fields.trivia: Heater was named after Jim Starlin's old girlfriend, Heather Devitt. As a blue-skinned humanoid with a tail, Heater has visual similarities to Nightcrawler.

heath benson.name: Heath Benson
heath benson.origin: Heath Benson was a onetime aerialist whose career ended after injuring himself in a performance. Benson became a ringmaster for the circus after this, but was jealous of the aerialist Whirlo, remembering his old role. To recapture the glory of his earlier career, he assumed the guise of the Rattler and performed daring acrobatic stunts as he robbed locals, both for the glory of astonishing onlookers, and to frame the innocent Whirlo for his crimes. The Rawhide Kid fell for this ruse and suspected Whirlo as being the Rattler. When he confronted the aerialist he was bested in combat before realizing his mistake. The Kid then went on to defeat and unmask the real Rattler, and sent him to prison. The Rattler soon escaped, however, and when Whirlo heard of this he decided to commit crimes dressed as the Rattler in order to frame him for revenge. Dressed as the Rattler, Whirlo robbed Tombstone of $10,000, and nearly set the Two-Gun Kid after the real Rattler, until he slipped up, accidentally mentioning the amount the Rattler had stolen before it had been made public. Whirlo was then apprehended and sent to prison. Whirlo's activities succeeded in drawing the real Rattler to Tombstone, where he joined Iron Mask's gang alongside several other costumed outlaws. The West Coast Avengers had travelled back in time to Tombstone and were able to assist the heroes of this time, Phantom Rider, Rawhide Kid, and the Two-Gun Kid in stopping the criminals reign of terror and capturing them. The Rattler had attempted to ambush Tigra, who quickly overpowered him and launched him at Hurricane, knocking out both villains.
abilities: The Rattler was a highly skilled athlete, and aerialist. He was incredibly quick and rather strong. He was also an experienced horseman and marksman.
weapons: Pistols
weaknesses: The Rattler had suffered an injury which left him no longer able to perform his acrobatic feats at the circus that he worked in.

heavy metal jacket.origin: The man who became Heavy Metal Jacket and his two partners worked at Stane International at the time when Obadiah Stane acquired Stark International. As engineers, they had the opportunity to study and reverse-engineer some of the tech from the Iron Man Armor, and worked even more freely after Stane's death. Creating their own armor, the trio went independent as the Iron Trinity. While trying to steal a sonic bomb from Stane Int'l, Killdozer, Heavy Metal Jacket and Steel-Fist were confronted by the Falcon. During the fight, the bomb went off and damaged their armor, forcing the Trinity to flee.

hecara.name: Hecara
hecara.origin: When Hela had taken over Valhalla and turned it into a reflection of her own realm, Niffleheim, Odin sent Hecara and the rest of the Valkyrior ahead of him to fight off Hela, but she and her sisters were slain by Hela's minions. When Odin got there, he plead with her to bring them back to life and stop her madness, but she explained that after a recent encounter with Thor and Lady Sif, she realized that she had wanted to express her own feelings of compassion and desire to be a woman, but could not since she was burdened with being the goddess of death. Odin then took pity on Hela and granted her the wisdom and knowledge she sought. She went back to Niffleheilm, allowing Valhalla to return to its original form, resurrecting Hecara and the rest of the Valkyries in the process.

hecla.name: Hecla
hecla.origin: Hecla lived in a planet that existed in a parallel dimension from the Earth's. When his world was conquered by Yod, Hecla lost his wife and son after they tried to defy their new ruler. One day while farming, Hecla and his peers encountered Thor, who had been banished to the dimension of Hecla's planet by Hydra. Hecla provided her with shelter and food after learning of Thor's story, but believed she was delusional. The following day, Hecla and Thor embarked in a journey to find a device that could teleport her home, an artifact located in Yod's lair. Before leaving his house, Hecla built Thor a hammer to compensate for her loss of Mjolnir, which had remained on Earth. On their journey, Hecla and Thor became friends as they shared anecdotes. When nearing Yod's lair, Thor effortlessly defeated a group of monsters that attacked them, changing Hecla's opinion on Thor's claims that she was a god. Thor also saved Hecla from being hit by a lightning cast by Yod while they were climbing his mountain. After reaching the top of the mountain, Hecla and Thor were confronted by Yod. While she confronted the monster, Hecla retrieved the device from its case. Unfortunately, Hecla was fatally struck by Yod's lightning while handing over the device to Thor. In an attempt to help Hecla find peace, Thor used the device's last charge on him. Hecla subsequently woke up in a vision of his world before Yod took over, and reunited with his family.

hector balboa.name: Hector Balboa
hector balboa.origin: Hector Balboa is a Mexican drug lord who had a DEA agent tortured over three days to find out what he knew about his operations, after which the agent was killed. Hector carved out a 40 acre ranch on the side of a mountain, with a runway hidden by canopy. Protecting his operation and assets were sicarios (assassins) on dirt motorcycles and a helicopter gunship. He had a fully equipped Cobra attack helicopter and two jet fighters (a Harrier and a Mirage), hidden under the canopy. The Punisher kidnapped the doctor who kept the DEA agent alive, and fought his way through Hector's private army, making it back to the United States.

hector birch.name: Hector Birch
hector birch.origin: Hector "Hec" Birch was president of the Satan's Lords, the biggest and nastiest biker gang in Arizona. The gang was involved in the manufacturing and dealing meth, and enjoyed raping and pillaging. It had a number of clubs, but Hec was based near Soda Springs with 30% of their strength. The Punisher infiltrated his club, posing as a meth cook. Soon afterwards, they were attacked by their rivals the Galloping Geese who took out the meth lab. Hec escaped with the Punisher to his girlfriend's hacienda to get more chemicals to set up a new meth lab. Getting high on meth, he became paranoid and turned on his lover (who was married) and the Punisher, believing they were in league with her husband. In the process he lost the chemicals and soon afterwards his life.

hector devasquez.name: Hector DeVasquez
hector devasquez.origin: Hector was the founder of Vasquez Research Technologies, an expert in gamma radiation, and a former colleague of Bruce Banner. He was present when Zapper, his son-in-law, began his attempts to revive the Sensational She-Hulk. Later, his daughter asked him to save her marriage, suspecting the Sensational She-Hulk of stealing her husband. He instead continued his plan to destroy the Sensational She-Hulk, which he started after becoming aware that Zapper still had feelings for her. He built War Zone, and engineered it to remove the Sensational She-Hulk’s power. After Jen survived, Hector tampered with Zapper’s equipment to make her savage, and when that failed, he built a tank to try and overload the Sensational She-Hulk, but it only made her more powerful. She then tried to kill him, but distracted by her father, she collapsed as her energy was expelled, and Hector was arrested.

hector munoz.name: Hector Muñoz
hector munoz.origin: Hector Muñoz was the father of Armando Muñoz, who would later become the X-Man Darwin. When his son, Armando, started showing signs of mutation, he denied that he was his son and left him in his mother's care. Years later, he hired X-Factor Investigations to find Armando, claiming to feel bad for walking out on him when he was a child. However, it was revealed that he only intended to get him back so that he could sell him to Project Karma in an attempt to earn half a million dollars. However, he was not paid, and instead was attempted to be murdered via a shot to the head. The shot did not kill him, but it rendered him mentally disabled. After Armando was freed by the X-Factor, his son went to see him in the hospital where he informed him that it would be hard to forgive him for his actions, but he would try to forget. Armando also told him that he could "rot in hell," before leaving.

hector ramone.name: Hector Ramone
hector ramone.origin: Born and raised in East L.A., Hector Ramone became a drug dealer, eventually moving to the Central American country of San Domingo. There, he became leader of a cartel that backed Captain de Ortega's regime. At some point, he became abusive and murdered his wife, driving his son Estaban to flee from him. He went to live with DEA agent Quincy Jefferson and his wife Angela, for which Ramone had the Jeffersons assassinated and their daughter Laura kidnapped. This drew the attention of the Punisher, who had been friends of the Jeffersons in Saigon during the Vietnam War. With Estaban's help, Laura was rescued and Ramone died in a confrontation with the Punisher, who later murdered de Ortega as well.

hector redondo.name: Hector Redondo
hector redondo.origin: After receiving a confession from a criminal who did almost every bad thing, Father Redondo was pushed over the edge when the man asked to have sins forgiven in order to commit more. Furious, Redondo grabbed an axe, opened the confessional door, and tore him to pieces. He then collapsed to the floor, begging God for forgiveness, as he'd done it again. He repeated this with others, as his cleaner, Mrs. Pearse was blind, deaf, and anosmic she only wiped up whatever was left after he'd put the bodies in garbage bags. He started calling himself the Holy but still despaired over the sins committed, until seeing a newspaper article describing the Punisher and started idolizing him and realized he was no longer alone. Officers Soap and von Richthofen investigated the deaths, but Redondo simply feigned innocence and then showed him out, while his as yet undiscovered fifth victim was sitting in his confession booth with an axe in his chest. He later joined a group called the Vigilante Squad with Mister Payback and Elite. They tried to convince Punisher to lead them, but instead, he killed all three.

hector rendoza.name: Hector Rendoza
hector rendoza.origin: Hector Rendoza was 16 years old when his mutant powers manifested. His skin became transparent, so he went to doctor for help, but was noticed by his neighbors. As they hadn't recognized him, and believed he was dangerous, they attacked Hector despite his pleas. He was saved from the crowd by Jean Grey. Jean recruited Hector into a new team of X-Men she led to Genosha to rescue Charles Xavier, who had been kidnapped by Magneto. On the way to Genosha, Jean gave Hector a telepathic crash course in using his powers and being an X-Man. During their fight with Magneto, Hector was able to transfer his invisibility field to Magneto, causing him sufficient disorientation for the others to complete the rescue of Xavier. Despite his pivotal role in the conflict, Hector left the X-Men, in hopes of discovering and learning his abilities on his own. Hector lost his mutant powers during M-Day.

hector risso.name: Hector Risso
hector risso.first_appearance: Untold Tales of Punisher Max Vol 1 4
hector risso.origin: Hector Risso was a Mexican crime boss who controlled a large network of human trafficking operations in Southern California. Following the murder of a young woman, a man approached the Punisher claiming to be her father, prompting the vigilante to investigate Risso’s operations. Risso relied on loyal henchmen such as Manuel and Jovi to secure his villa and manage his illicit trade. During the Punisher’s infiltration, Lewis’ interrogation revealed Risso’s central role in the criminal enterprise. As the Punisher moved to eliminate the trafficker, an unexpected figure intervened—Xiang, posing as the grieving father. Despite Xiang’s deception, Risso was confronted by the Punisher and killed.

hector santiago.name: Hector Santiago
hector santiago.origin: Hector Santiago is a sadistic dictator in South America who rules the country of Rio de Muerte. He is based at a giant prison facility where he tortures it's inmates and keeps his cousin, Donna Maria captive. Eventually, one of his prisoners escapes to the United States of America and Swine sends spies to retrieve him. However, they accidentally kill him and take Captain America instead. On the way there, Captain America breaks free and crashes the plane and escapes. Swine and his men confront him but quickly lose and Steve leaves to go find food, but decides to overthrow Swine after seeing how starved the people are. At the same time, Arnim Zola resurfaces and creates a monster called Man-Fish to kill Captain America. It attacks Captain America but Swine's men chase it away. They then attempt to capture Captain America but he runs away and falls into a pit. Swine then attempts to kill him in the pit, but Man-Fish, who they attacked earlier ambushes and kills Swine.

hector silva.name: Hector Silva
hector silva.origin: Hector Silva was a teacher at Ciudad Leando University in Ciudad Leando, capital of the small Latin American nation Bosqueverde. Silva was friends with Ricardo Dominguez, who was eventually elected President of Bosqueverde. Six months after the ellection, General Emmanuel Rodrigo Raposa led a socialist uprising against the government, the "Raposistas", that eventually killed President Dominguez in front of Dominguez's wife Carmilla when they reached the president's office at the Presidential Palace. The killing shots were made by one of Raposa's mercenaries Marc Spector, with his fellow mercenary Bo Ollsen also in the room. Raposa had promised to create a new representative government with democratic reforms; but instead established a ferocious dictatorship in Bosqueverde, repeatedly violating human rights and spilling so much blood that his regime was considered the bloodiest in Latin America. He appointed torturer César Bajete as the general of his Secret Police, and put him in command of his death squads. Dominguez's supporters refused to recognize Raposa's legitimacy, and arranged guerrilla attacks against the new President's interests. This led to ten years of civil war that devastated the population with poverty, disease and mutilation while battles took place village by village. Critical of the organization of the resistance was Silva. After a decade, the resistance defeated Raposa's forces, but Raposa managed to escape the country before being captured. Some of his allies, including Bajete, were arrested. However, many Raposa supporters remained at large, awaiting their leader's return. Many people turned to Silva to become the new President; Silva himself would have rather return to his position as a teacher, but reluctantly gave in to his supporters' request, and was soon democratically ellected, with Carmilla Dominguez serving as his Vice President. The new democratic government immediately devoted efforts to prosecute and punish the Raposistas for war crimes and human rights violations, but they were unable to find and arrest Raposa or Ollsen. Bosqueverde hired Symkarian mercenary group Wild Pack to bring Spector, by then an American millionaire, to Bosqueverde, which they did but not with all democratic guarantees. The public trial then started at Estadio E. Jacovone in Ciudad Leando; Bajete, Spector and other Raposistas (Earth-616) were tried simultaneously, with President Silva presiding and Vice President Dominguez sitting with him. During the nights of those days, Vice President Dominguez worked up late with President Silva, trying to convince him that he was doing a good work and that the trials were neccessary. The trial was also defective, as Spector's lawyer did not even speak English and the public demanded a morbid spectacle: Survivors of Raposa's death squads and mutilated victims were presented as witnesses, and when Spector tried to not look at them, Silva insisted that he did. The trial also kept the accused under scorching sun for long. After a week of trial, Vice President Dominguez testified about her husband's murder. Spector was then found guilty of insurrection and of the murder of President Dominguez, and was sentenced to be hung in two days, along with several other Raposistas. Bajete and the Raposistas had planned to escape prison and assassinate Silva in vengeance and to cause a political change that could bring Raposa back to Bosqueverde. After the sentence, the escaped prison, with Spector reluctantly joining them, but Spector opposed to their murderous plans, so the Raposistas battered him and left him for dead before going on with their plan. Spector was saved by his allies, his friend Frenchie and his girlfriend Marlene Alraune, who were trying to rescue him - but Spector insisted that he morally needed to save Silva, even if Silva had sentenced him to die. Bajete's Raposista team, with green scarves around their necks attacked the Palace, blowing the outer wall to distract the army while they entered the building itself. Bajete and several of his men reached the President's office, and Bajete personally put a gun on Silva's head but Spector, in his secret identity as the Moon Knight, sneaked in the Palace and helped in the defense, reaching the President's office in time. Surprised at Spector's appearance, Bajete took him for a fantasma at first, but refused to release the President. Spector easily defeated the other Raposistas there, then threatened Bajete. From a building across the street, Frenchie sharpshot Bajete, wounding his right shoulder, then Spector knocked him down. Silva first asked whether Bajete was dead, and Spector told him he was not. Silva admitted that the Moon Knight scared him; then Moon Knight negotiated with Silva to get him pardon Spector, in exchange for him bringing Raposa to Bosqueverde's justice. heidi devoto.name: Heidi Devoto
heidi devoto.origin: Heidi Devoto is a self-interested and cynical actress who moved to New York City to pursure her career. After several years of doing auditions and failing to get parts, she agreed to accept an assignment from the Kingpin, using makeup and a wig to pose as Kingpin's wife Vanessa Fisk. She knew the job would be very dangerous, but he offered her twenty thousand dollars per week, and she gladly accepted. She recorded a video message to be played if she was ever harmed while working and instructed that it be sent to Kansas, revealing that she was working with the Kingpin. thumb|left|150px|Heidi's death As Vanessa, Heidi was kidnapped off the streets by the Kingorge tribe, and taken to the home of Micah Synn. There, she was placed in the front of a large idol of the god Mow, on the floor next to Becky Blake, who was paralyzed from the waist down. Both women were tied up and as the Kingorge chanted, a spike platform was slowly lowered by Vikah that would crush both women to death. It wouldn't be long when Daredevil entered and the plunged the room into darkness. Trying to run to safety, Heidi rushed to aid Becky and helped her toward the elevator. After getting Becky safely on board the elevator, the Vikah threw a spear, hitting Heidi in the back and killing her. Her video tape was taken by the Kingpin before it could be sent to Kansas in order to protect his identity.

heidi franklin.origin: Heidi Franklin was an exotic dancer before being used by Genetech for their research in creating superhuman beings. Given powers and the name of Pretty Persuasions, she became a member of Psionex. The group's early early activities included battling the young heroes of the New Warriors. When Psionex eventually escaped Genetech, Pretty Persuasions returned to exotic dancing. She later worked at a gentlemen's club frequented by Speed Demon. ===Civil War=== When the Commission on Superhuman Activities persuaded the Thunderbolts to track down super-villains and recruit them to join the pro-registration side of the Superhuman Registration Act, Pretty Persuasions was among those who accepted the offer. ===Dark Reign=== She later rejoined Psionex, who were made the official Initiative team of Maryland team. She participated in the H.A.M.M.E.R. assault on Asgard.

heidi sladkin.origin: Heidi Sladkin aka Riot is a punk rocker member of the Skrull Kill Krew. Riot is one of the victims of the Skrull-turned-cow-turned-hamburger known as Skrullovoria Induced Skrullophobia. In her human form, Riot is a cute redhead with a short buzz cut, but after eating the Skrull meat, she transformed into a massive, beastly creature with sharp teeth, massive tusks and an insectoid carapace. Like most of the Skrull Kill Krew, Riot has shapeshifting powers, but in her insect form, she has great strength and sharp spines. She was stuck in that form for an extended period of time. Riot and Ryder joined up with 3-D Man during the Secret Invasion because of his ability to see the new super-powered Skrulls in their native form and went on a hunt for all the Skrulls who had infiltrated the 50-State Initiative. During the tail-end of the Secret Invasion, Riot altered herself back to her human form, succumbing to the fatal transition and passing away as a human. It is later revealed that she survived, working with Ryder grudgingly. Riot was also looking on Match.com for a lesbian dating partner, though she had trouble reverting back to her human form again. Due to the degenerative properties of the infection, Moonstomp, Catwalk, and Dice's bodies eventually start to rot away. Riot and Ryder preserved their teammates' heads in cryo-stasis. This was done as they knew they could only be brought back for one last mission. Eventually she finally learns to control her transformation from insectoid to human form. Riot met a Skrull named Eva and fell in love with her. Riot had to repeatedly defend her against the other members of the Skrull Kill Krew. Eva eventually became an inactive part of the Skrull Kill Krew, riding with Heidi.
powers: Riot had the shape-shifting abilities, as she could turn into an insectoid form.
abilities: Riot is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter.

heindrich von wilhelm innsbruck.name: Heindrich von Wilhelm Innsbruck
heindrich von wilhelm innsbruck.origin: left|thumb|The Planner as he appeared in 1942 Heindrich von Wilhelm Innsbruck was born in Prussia in the early 19th Century. He was a classmate of Otto Bismarck and assisted him throughout most of his life. Innsbruck was able to extend his life due to the scientific achievements of German scientists who transformed him into a cyborg. During the Second World War, Innsbruck was responsible for all of Germany's military strategy. His secret headquarters was in a castle in the Swiss Alps that he personally oversaw the construction of in 1840. This castle was raided in 1942 by Nick Fury and his Howling Commandos when they learned of Innsbruck's existence. Innsbruck's men initially captured the Commandos and he planned to use them for scientific experimentation before they were able to escape and blow up the castle, seemingly killing the immobile Innsbruck. Somehow, however, Innsbruck managed to survive and went into hiding at the end of the war, like many other Nazi war criminals. He was believed dead until the Fall of 1959, when Fury's Avengers black ops team discovered him at ICON's Madripoor mansion headquarters as he had been recruited as the main strategist for ICON. During the ensuing struggle, Innsbruck was assaulted by Sabretooth, but was able to successfully defend himself using his new highly sophisticated cybernetics. He was soon taken prisoner, however, by the combined might of Namora and the Blonde Phantom. He was soon coerced into revealing ICON's planned assault on the secret African nation of Wakanda, giving the Avengers a chance to get there before ICON's assault team.

heinrich bungler.name: Heinrich Bungler
heinrich bungler.origin: Heinrich Bungler was a commanding officer of the Gestapo during World War II. He was notoriously brutal, earning him the name "Bungler the Butcher". In the spring of 1941, Adolf Hitler directly ordered Bungler to capture the Destroyer. To this end, Bungler arranged the execution of Pastor Muller, a local priest who was vocally against Hitler's regime, in the hopes that it would draw out the Destroyer. Bungler's plan worked, and he and his men caught the Destroyer as he attempted to sneak into the compound where Muller was being held. Despite the fact that the Destroyer had cut his hands open while attempting to climb the perimeter wall, he still managed to escape after playing possum and grabbing Bungler and using him as a human shield. The cowardly Bungler fainted when he was almost shot by one of his own men, allowing the Destroyer to flee the scene and get medical attention for his hands. Regaining his composure, Bungler then focused on torturing the pastor, whipping him in a vein attempt to get the pastor to retract what he has said against Hitler. When this failed, Bungler personally saw Muller to the chopping block and almost succeeded in beheading the priest if not for the timely arrival of the Destroyer. Beating Bungler into submission, the hero put Bungler's head on the chopping block and threaten to chop his head off. This was all a ruse to frighten Bungler to faint again, allowing the Destroyer to escape to freedom with Muller. Bungler's subsequent fate is unrevealed.
weapons: Bungler was armed with a Luger pistol. When torturing his victims, he used a whip.
weaknesses: When violence was threatened against him, Bungler would immediately faint.

heinrich himmelman.name: Heinrich Himmelman
heinrich himmelman.origin: Heinrich Himmelman was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In the spring of 1943, he sought to be smuggled out of the United States to avoid capture by American authorities. He sought the aid of his fellow spy Mr. Kutz who had Himmelman disguise himself as a gorilla and hide him in the monkey house of the local zoo. However, his cover was blown thanks -- ironically enough -- when Deadline Dawson was assigned to the "zoo beat" by his editor after failing to provide sufficient evidence to prove that Mr. Kurtz was a Nazi spy in a published story, which Kurtz complained about. It was there that his friend Terry Vance's pet monkey Dr. Watson noticed that the gorilla in the cage was no ape. Himmelman was unmasked and then taken into police custody. His subsequent fate is unknown.

However during his servitude to Dracula he created a device called a Projector, a device that could resurrect the dead as vampires. After being poisoned by Quincy Harker, Dracula forced Mortte to perform a complete blood transfusion to expunge the poison from his body. He then forced Heinrich to bring him the Projector. However, when Dracula sent his army of vampires to kill Heinrich's daughter, Mortte battled Dracula, and destroyed the device. Horrified at what he had helped create, Mortte killed himself by purposely impaling himself on the fence posts of a cemetery.

heinrich von betz.origin: Heinrich von Betz was one of the most desperate, cunning man in the Nazi secret service, aka the Gestapo. He was somehow captured in the July of 1941, and transported with a deportee train, where he planned his escape. He activated a gas bomb, and let every guard in the room die. Leaving behind a trail of death, he planned to uncouple train, before dealing with the gentlemen in the engine cab. Killing both of the train drivers, he was defeated by the Patriot in a short fight. Heinrich confessed to the Patriot about his "friends" who were fifteen miles away and gave him the gas bomb and the gas mask, and then planned to organize a campaign of sabotage. He was then given to the authorities as a prisoner of war. Heinrich von Betz's fate following the war is unknown.

heka nut.name: Heka-Nut
heka nut.origin: In his youth, the brilliant sorcerer Heka-Nut was selected to act as the intermediary between the four primal gods of the Ogdoad: Atum (also known as "Amun" to the Ogdoad), who ruled the air and the invisible; Nun/Nu of the primordial waters; Hauhet, whose influence was space and visible matter; and Keku, whose domain was darkness and chaos. Heka-Nut served the Ogdoad faithfully for a thousand years until Keku tempted the sorcerer and corrupted him. Following his corruption by Keku, Heka-Nut searched for the legendary Sword of Bone for 500 years until he located it in Egypt's Valley of the Kings. For centuries thereafter, he unsuccessfully attempted to circumvent the many traps and spells that protected the Sword of Bone. In the 11th century BCE, Heka-Nut captured Ashake and a time-displaced Magik and forced them to recover the Sword of Bone for him in exchange for their freedom. He betrayed them, but was unable to wield the Sword of Bone because only the pure of soul can call upon its power. He was struck down by Magik's Soulsword and left an empty vessel while Ashake trapped his dark power in an Egyptian urn and hid it away along with the Sword of Bone in its ancient resting place.

hektu.name: Hektu
hektu.origin: Hektu was a Dakkamite who lived on his people's homeworld of Dakkam with his wife Soja. At one time he was known as his planet's greatest astronomer. At some point after his wife had either given birth to their son or had become pregnant, Hektu's observations of Dakkam's sun led him to believe that it was going to go nova in a year. Hektu brought his theory to the ruling Triumvirate and asked them to give him funds to build a fleet of spaceships that could take the Dakkamite people to a different solar system. The Triumvirate was initially amused by Hektu's theory but when he described in graphic detail how Dakkam would be destroyed they ceased to find him amusing. The leader of the Triumvirate, Ninox, denounced his theories as morbid fantasies and called him mad, then warned Hektu that, if he tried to spread his ridiculous theories among the populace or in any way disturbed Dakkam's calm, he would be put away for life. Although he still wanted to save his people, Hektu realized that he couldn't do anything for them if their society didn't wish to be bothered, so he instead concentrated on saving his family. Unaware that the Triumvirate had decided to have him discretely watched, Hektu worked for six Earth-months to build a spaceship with D-warp engines that could carry his family away from Dakkam to anywhere in the galaxy. After the spaceship was finished, Hektu and Soja were preparing to leave with their infant son when the Internal Security Police burst into the launch bay. Having known of Hektu's spacecraft, the Triumvirate had decided that Dakkam's billions should never look upon it or hear Haktu's mad theories, so the police had been sent to seize the spacecraft and to silence Hektu, which they did by killing him with a single shot. Since Soja was a witness and could speak out about Hektu's death and why he had been killed, the police also shot Soja, but she remained alive just long enough to get their son into the spaceship and pull the lever that launched it into space. After a year had passed and Dakkam's sun had not gone nova, it was concluded that Hektu had gone mad. However, the Triumvirate now became concerned that Hektu's son Wundarr might one day return to Dakkam to avenge his father's death. To prevent that from happening, they sent Zeneg, Tuumar and a Mortoid robot assassin to search out and kill Wundarr. The Dakkamites found Wundarr on Earth, twenty-two years after he had crashed there, and attempted to eliminate him, but he was protected by the Thing and the Sub-Mariner who destroyed the robot and forced the two Dakkamites to flee.

helen.name: Helen
helen.origin: ===Early Life=== Helen was the mortal daughter of Leda,{{r|Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe Vol 1 12| & ; Zeus' profile}} a mortal Aetolian princess, and of the Olympian ruler Zeus,{{r|Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe Vol 1 12| & ; Zeus' profile}} and the sister of Castor and Pollux. Helen was believed to be the daughter of Tyndareus. The most beautiful mortal woman, she was married off to King Menelaus of Sparta, and they had a child together. Category:History Expansion Needed ===Trojan War=== The Trojan War was a war between Greece and the City of Troy. The strife began after the Trojan prince Paris abducted Helen. When Menelaus demanded her return, the Trojans refused. Menelaus then persuaded his brother Agamemnon to lead an army against Troy. Category:History Expansion Needed Category:History Expansion Needed ===Modern Era=== In the 1940s, Helen of Troy joined many of the Olympian pantheon in relocating to the Planet Venus while they were temporarily under the rule of Venus. In 1948, when Venus briefly operated as a model and editor for Beauty Magazine on Earth, she brought Helen and other goddesses back to Earth to appear in a magazine spread to rival Lovely Lady Magazine's next issue that boasted to have 10 of the most beautiful women on the planet. Helen's contribution to Beauty Magazine's rival spread helped it outsell the competition.

fields.trivia: When it looked like The Incredible Hulk might be cancelled in season 4, series creator Kenneth Johnson (in an effort to save the series) suggested a season 5 opening episode, where Helen would return. Helen would be revealed to be suffering from a blood disease, and require a blood transfusion from her brother to survive. Such an episode was never produced. However, concerns that the show would eventually do a female Hulk had prompted Marvel Comics to create She-Hulk, to ensure the copyright to such a character.

helen burnside.name: Helen Burnside
helen burnside.origin: Helen Burnside was a member of the Gauntlet, and worked for Mr. Beckham. During the investigation into the death of a fellow Gauntlet member, Beckham fired his assistant, Lau, and promoted Helen to replace him. When Helen stepped aboard an elevator with her boss, she was horrified to see Beckham torn apart from the inside by a Down-Spiral monster. Taken to the hospital, Helen met X-Man, who telekinetically rearranged her brain chemistry to calm her down. He asked her to take him to the other Gauntlet members, as it was his duty as "shaman" to mutants to protect them. When Nate found out that the Down-Spiral creatures were going after the Gauntlet because the Gauntlet had kidnapped their children to harvest their highly-adaptable organs, he abandoned them, including Helen, in the Down-Spiral dimension, where she was presumably killed by the beasts.
powers: Unrevealed

helen taylor.name: Helen Taylor
helen taylor.species: Human imbued with the Nova Force
helen taylor.origin: left|thumb Helen Taylor's life was turned upside down when a mugger murdered her husband. She vowed that the man who killed her husband would pay. However as the months would carry on, there would be no trace of the murderer, and Helen became increasingly bitter and her thirst for revenge would grow. One day while praying to her husband she hoped for some miracle to come and help her bring justice. Coincidentally, this would be at the time that Rhomann Dey transferred his Nova powers to some random human being on the planet. Helen's prayers were answered in the form of her being endowed with the power of a Nova. Driven by the need for vengeance, Helen began a one-woman crusade against the underworld in order to seek out her husband's killer. Those who were unable to provide her with information were killed by her hands. Of her many victims, the most notable of them was the Kingpin. Her vigilante activities gained the attention of the government, and with their growing concern about her activities requested the Fantastic Four to capture her. Although she gave the group of famous super-heroes a good fight, she was defeated in combat by the Invisible Girl. Examined by Mr. Fantastic, the Fantastic Four leader found no way to neutralize her powers and decided to exile her to the Negative Zone so that she would be no harm to anyone. Ironically, the killer of Helen's husband would be found dead shortly after -- having driven his car into Long Island Sound not long after the tragedy.
powers: Nova Force

helen volcano.name: Helen Volcano
helen volcano.origin: Helen Volcano was an Ultra firestarter who worked with the Denver PD for a time. After a man from Aladdin offered her money to participate in a cover-up, she accepted to acquire enough money to raise her son. Helen firebombed a morgue to burn up evidence of the corpses inside, but after learning she was complicit in the cover-up of a senator's assassination, Helen was wracked with guilt. She confessed everything to UltraForce when they came investigating. Once Ultraforce left, however, Helen and her infant son were both murdered by the assassin, Dog.

helene.name: Helene
helene.origin: Helene and her mate Flavius were housecats that were transformed into humanoid cats by the kind wizard Ebrok. Eventually a group of wizards including Ebrok, Orann, Belasco and Yanthon banished Flavius, Helene, and their descendants to the Land Within in fear that they would become a threat to humanity. Helene and Flavius evaded the banishment of their people by using Cat's Head Amulets to disguise themselves as human. They would go on to create the first Tigra after being unable turn housecats into Cat People they used a Human woman named Florence. Florence as the first Tigra defeated Flavius and Helene's enemies which allowed them to summon a Balkatar named Tegnar who fell in love with Tigra and the two spawned a second group of Cat People. Flavius unleashed a strain of the plague commonly known as the Black Death when he flung a beaker containing it at Ebrok's killer Orann.

helenus.name: Helenus
helenus.origin: ===Origin=== Helenus and Cassandra were the twin sibling children of King Priam and Hecuba of Troy. As children, they fell asleep in the temple, and the sacred serpents licked their ears. From that moment, the twins were gifted with the power of prophecy. Cassandra was later cursed by Apollo so no one would ever believe her. ===Paris=== After Paris returned from his secret exile (his mother had dreamed of him as firebrand, and it had been foretold by prophets that he would be the ruin of Troy), Helenus and Cassandra went to him to dissuade him from his project of taking Helen of Sparta for his wife (as he had been promised by Aphrodite) warning him that he would bring destruction, but neither convinced him. ===Trojan War=== In the last year of the Trojan War, after their brother Hector's death at the hand of Achilles, Helenus and Cassandra welcomed the arrival of Penthesilea and twelve of her Amazons. One night, Helenus went to a far temple of Apollo, but was intercepted by Odysseus who bad been informed by priest and seer Calchas that he would find him there. Threatening him, he obtained of him the keys to the fall of Troy: The Achaeans had to steal the Palladium (Athena's image) from the temple of Athena; the city would not fall until the Bow of Heracles loosed arrows against it (that bow was used by Philoctetes, a warrior left behind during the crossing of the Aegean Sea due to his wound); and that the war wouldn't end without the support of the son of Achilles, Neoptolemus. Helenus was possibly kept captive by the Achaeans, although he was seen fleeing after Odysseus got the information he wished from him.
powers: Helenus possessed the power of prophecy.

family: Hector, Paris, Deiphobus, Pammon, Polites, Antiphonus (brothers) Cassandra, Polyxena (sisters) Lycaon (half-brother)

helium element.origin: Helium was one of the synthetic soldiers called the Elements of Doom, and clashed with the Thunderbolts. Eventually, the Elements of Doom were acquired by the mutant-hating organization Orchis: they were reprogrammed by Agent Woodrow Pequod of the Culture/Narrative branch to be ruthless and to serve their cause. hellen feliciano.name: Hellen Feliciano
hellen feliciano.species: Human mutated by the Power Broker
hellen feliciano.origin: ===Early Years=== Hellen Feliciano was a protégé of Ann "Auntie Freeze" Fraley, one of the leading female wrestlers of thirty years ago. Feliciano was trained by Fraley and wrestled under the alias of Letha. Eventually, under Fraley's management, Letha teamed up with three other female wrestlers Fraley had trained -- Poundcakes, Screaming Mimi, and Titania -- to become the wrestling team known as the original Grapplers. Letha remained a member of the Grapplers throughout their early career, even when the team began their criminal activities. During the Grapplers' association with the Roxxon Oil Company, Letha was given special leather belts and straps with various weaponry stitched within them. With these new weapons, the Grapplers were sent to accompany Thundra to Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.'s research facility, where they were ordered to sabotage and destroy the facility's equipment. During the mission, Letha and Screaming Mimi fought Quasar, though they were eventually defeated and sent to prison. At Ryker's Island, Letha and the Grapplers rose to power. When Dazzler was imprisoned alongside them, the Grapplers attempted to kill her as punishment for Klaw's death. However, Dazzler managed to overcome the Grapplers when she reflected Screaming Mimi's voice back at them. When the Grapplers were paroled, they sought out the Thing in order to make him pay for his assistance in putting them in prison. The four ladies were ultimately defeated by Captain America and the X-Men, though they quickly recovered and joined dozens of supervillains who also wished to find the Thing. The army of supervillains was stopped by a large group of superheroes, and in the ensuing battle, Letha fought Sasquatch. ===Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation=== Letha and the Grapplers soon found that the public had lost interest in the women's wrestling movement. However, Auntie Freeze assembled several new Grapplers and formed a women's division in the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. Letha joined the federation and underwent treatment to gain superhuman strength and durability from the Power Broker. The Grapplers ended their lives of crime and became legitimate wrestlers, though Letha and the original Grapplers felt resentment towards the newcomers. One such newcomer, Battleaxe, made a splash with the Grapplers when she defeated Letha's best friend Titania and became spokesperson for the Grapplers. Losing the support of her teammates, Titania left for the showers only to be killed by the enigmatic vigilante Scourge, who was disguised as a female wrestler named Golddigger. ===Death=== Wishing to avenge her friend, Letha traveled to the Bar With No Name in Medina County, Ohio. She met with several other supervillains to discuss the Scourge of the Underworld. However, the Scourge disguised himself as a bartender and shot and killed each supervillain in attendance, including Letha. ===Resurrection=== Years later, the Hood resurrected Letha, Titania (taking the new codename Lascivious), and several other victims of the Scourge. The Hood bestowed new powers on Letha - the power to open the part of the brain that regulates aggression. This causes her opponents to go berserk with rage directed at anyone she chooses. She demonstrated her abilities by forcing her teammate Cyclone beat Mind-Wave. The Hood allowed the group to live as long as they killed the Punisher. In order to get the Punisher's attention, Letha used her powers on several veterans in a support group. The Punisher tracked Letha and Lascivious down, though they were also found by Spider-Man. Letha used her powers on Spider-Man to get him to kill Punisher, but he failed. Letha is later knocked out by a falling billboard during their escape. Lascivious uses her lust powers on Spider-Man, allowing them to escape from the Punisher. Letha and Lascivious took over leadership of the rest of the newly-revived villains, and led them on another mission to kill the Punisher. The Punisher discovered their plan and killed several of the villains. Frustrated, Letha used her powers on the survivors to seek out and kill the Punisher once and for all. When they next met, Letha lifted a bus full of civilians to throw at her enemy, but the Punisher managed to wrap her legs with an electrified whip. She dropped the bus on herself and later escaped the fight. ===Grapplers Reunited=== Although they failed to kill the Punisher, the Hood allowed Letha and Lascivious to live as they were next seen reuniting the Grapplers. With Poundcakes and a brand new Screaming Mimi, Letha and Lascivious attacked the original Mimi, Songbird. However, Songbird managed to defeat her former teammates. Letha and Lascivious later became members of the Masters of Evil in Bagalia. Letha also joined Poundcakes and the second Titania at a bar where Letha mocked Wonder Man's filmography. The four ladies were ultimately defeated by Captain America and the X-Men, though they quickly recovered and joined dozens of supervillains who also wished to find the Thing. The army of supervillains was stopped by a large group of superheroes, and in the ensuing battle, Letha fought Sasquatch. ===Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation=== Letha and the Grapplers soon found that the public had lost interest in the women's wrestling movement. However, Auntie Freeze assembled several new Grapplers and formed a women's division in the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. Letha joined the federation and underwent treatment to gain superhuman strength and durability from the Power Broker. The Grapplers ended their lives of crime and became legitimate wrestlers, though Letha and the original Grapplers felt resentment towards the newcomers. One such newcomer, Battleaxe, made a splash with the Grapplers when she defeated Letha's best friend Titania and became spokesperson for the Grapplers. Losing the support of her teammates, Titania left for the showers only to be killed by the enigmatic vigilante Scourge, who was disguised as a female wrestler named Golddigger. ===Death=== Wishing to avenge her friend, Letha traveled to the Bar With No Name in Medina County, Ohio. She met with several other supervillains to discuss the Scourge of the Underworld. However, the Scourge disguised himself as a bartender and shot and killed each supervillain in attendance, including Letha. ===Resurrection=== Years later, the Hood resurrected Letha, Titania (taking the new codename Lascivious), and several other victims of the Scourge. The Hood bestowed new powers on Letha - the power to open the part of the brain that regulates aggression. This causes her opponents to go berserk with rage directed at anyone she chooses. She demonstrated her abilities by forcing her teammate Cyclone beat Mind-Wave. The Hood allowed the group to live as long as they killed the Punisher. In order to get the Punisher's attention, Letha used her powers on several veterans in a support group. The Punisher tracked Letha and Lascivious down, though they were also found by Spider-Man. Letha used her powers on Spider-Man to get him to kill Punisher, but he failed. Letha is later knocked out by a falling billboard during their escape. Lascivious uses her lust powers on Spider-Man, allowing them to escape from the Punisher. Letha and Lascivious took over leadership of the rest of the newly-revived villains, and led them on another mission to kill the Punisher. The Punisher discovered their plan and killed several of the villains. Frustrated, Letha used her powers on the survivors to seek out and kill the Punisher once and for all. When they next met, Letha lifted a bus full of civilians to throw at her enemy, but the Punisher managed to wrap her legs with an electrified whip. She dropped the bus on herself and later escaped the fight. ===Grapplers Reunited=== Although they failed to kill the Punisher, the Hood allowed Letha and Lascivious to live as they were next seen reuniting the Grapplers. With Poundcakes and a brand new Screaming Mimi, Letha and Lascivious attacked the original Mimi, Songbird. However, Songbird managed to defeat her former teammates. Letha and Lascivious later became members of the Masters of Evil in Bagalia. Letha also joined Poundcakes and the second Titania at a bar where Letha mocked Wonder Man's filmography. fields.notes: Dr. Rachelson, along with Dr. Stancheck and Professor Sturdy, was created as part of Project Ns staff by Jim Shooter and John Byrne and fully seen and named in . Their presence during the events of was revealed in the Official Index to the Marvel Universe: Uncanny X-Men, implying they were the same people as a trio of scientists shown mutating the original Ani-Men in a flashback. This group of scientists, it should be noted, was not named and were vaguely depicted, and no reference to this procedure nor involvement by Rachelson, Stancheck, and Sturdy was mentioned in the pages of Avengers #164. That they are the same people is thus a retcon imposed by an editorial decision entirely based on a pair of super-power bestowing projects funded by Count Nefaria.

helliana.name: Helliana
helliana.first_appearance: Conan: Lord of the Spiders Vol 1 1
helliana.origin: Helliana was born on a farm not far from Yezud. When she was just a kid, Harpagus came by to demand half of her family's small herd of cattle. Her parents refused, so Harpagus had them slain on the spot, and then raped Helliana. Left alone, Helliana was only able to overcome her traumatic experience by blotting out her memory of her past. Helliana spent her childhood and teen life growing up a thief on the streets of Arenjun, determined to make it and become rich, no matter the cost. She and Sabo entered the ruined Elephant Tower, where they met Harpagus. She didn't recognize Harpagus as her childhood tormentor because of her mental block, and agreed to bring Conan to him. She attempted to ambush the Cimmerian in Shadizar with the help of Robwood and Gahad. As time passed, however, Helliana's memory of the tortures Harpagus had inflicted upon her eventually returned. Some time later, she came to rescue Conan as he was trapped by Zath in Arenjun, killing Abdol, but the lotus-mad Cimmerian mistook her for Zath and tried to kill her. Once he recovered, she brought him to her place and cooked a gruel, so that it would help Conan shake the lotus. When Captain Finar and his soldiers busted in, she escaped with Conan and brought him to the Tower of the Elephant, searching for the white lotus, the fasted antidote to the black lotus. When they finally confronted Zath, she threw herself into the fire, seemingly burning together with the Lord of the Spiders. She somehow survived and ended up in Koth where she saved Conan by pushing a flaming hovel between him and Lord Thun'da, enabling Conan to flee.

helmsman.name: Helmsman
helmsman.origin: The Helmsman was an alien creature who telepathically commanded the Cormorant on a mission to scour the Earth in search of a mysterious artifact. During the Brotherhood of Badoon's invasion of Earth, the Helmsman had the Cormorant to began gathering the missing pieces of the Alpha/Omega Armor with the exception of the helmet, which Helmsman already possessed. After all the pieces of the armor were gathered, Helmsman sent Cormorant to retrieve the Tactigon, the only weapon that could counter the armor. The Tactigon was in the possession of Doctor Doom, which he retrieved to fight Cormorant. After a short fight, Doom revealed to Cormorant that he was fighting him so he could locate Helmsman's location through his constant communications with Cormorant. Doom then teleported Helmsman to his location and disintegrated him with a burst of magical energy.
powers: The Helmsman appears to be a telepath, communicating with the Cormorant via his thoughts and being able to see through his eyes.

hendricks.name: Hendricks
hendricks.origin: In 1958, during the Cuban revolution, Logan finds himself entrenched in a covert mission in Cuba, surveilling the revolutionaries Fidel Castro and Che Guevara with his partner Hendricks. However, when communication with Hendricks is abruptly severed, Logan's solitude is shattered by the sudden appearance of unexpected allies: Jimmy Woo, Gorilla Man , and the enigmatic M-11. Their claim to be FBI agents doesn't quite add up, especially when faced with a talking gorilla. Tensions escalate swiftly as Gorilla Man attempted to apprehend Logan, only for the wily mutant to slip free and launch a vicious attack on Jimmy Woo. Shockingly, Logan draws blood with his blade, but the true nature of the threat becomes apparent when a monstrous insect emerges from Woo's neck. With grim realization, the group recognizes the insidious danger posed by Yellow Claw's mind-controlling bugs. Determined to uncover the extent of the threat, Woo sends the deceased insect to Marvel Boy and Venus for analysis, while extending a reluctant apology to Logan for the misunderstanding. Their uneasy alliance leads them to Hendricks, only to discover him under the sway of the very creatures they've been combating. Faced with the grim reality of irreversible mind control, Logan is forced to make a gut-wrenching decision, swiftly killing his infected partner. The act sparks dissent among the group, with Woo urging Logan to join Department Zero for debriefing. Refusing to be bound by anyone's agenda, Logan triggers planted explosives and vanishes into the jungle, leaving the agents behind. As the Agents of Atlas depart from Cuba, unaware of the sinister reach of Yellow Claw's influence, the shadow of impending doom looms large, with the revelation that even the leaders of the Cuban revolution may have fallen prey to the mind-controlling bugs.

With the success of the plan to dispose of the tyrant's minions, Belavia was set free.

henri le pym.name: Henri Le Pym
henri le pym.origin: Henri Le Pym was a natural philosopher and scientist who was coerced and blackmailed by Baron Victor Octavius into finding a cure for the Baron's octopus/hybrid state as his shrunken wife Janette was under hostage. And also for the Baron to offer Pym in helping to unshrink his wife. Pym used the blood of witchbreeds, including his colleague Hal McCoy, in formulating his concoctions for the Baron. In his experiments, Pym required the use of illegal dinosaur eggs from the New World, in which was brought in by Peter Parquagh. Pym was then confronted by a sickly Norman Osborne, who was infected with gangrene and requested his help in return for helping Pym acquire some of Peter's blood for his experiments. After Peter was captured, Pym extracted a sample from Peter's blood. Though, it was not enough when French officers came to arrest him and Octavius. In the confusion after McCoy was set freed, Pym escaped with Octavius and managed to extract the needed blood for his elixir for Octavius. However, Pym only discovered that Octavius had finally progressed into his final form and became mad, believing that he was superior over mankind. Pym's work was purposely spilled over by Octavius and worse to see his wife had been further mutated by Octavius into a human/wasp hybrid. Pym licked what little use of his elixir and attacked Octavius, but to be overpowered and thrown into Venice's canals. Moments later when Octavius had the advantage over the Spider, Pym emerged as a giant due to licking the elixir and took revenge on Octavius by stepping on the Baron thus killing him. After bidding goodbye to the Spider, Henri and Janette traveled back to one of Pym's labs in France, where he will use his own blood to manufacture a cure for the couple.
powers: Through an elixir, Pym was able to grow into a giant, presumably giving him a proportional increase in strength and durability.

henri sorel.origin: thumb|left|200px Henri Sorel was a research physicist with World Health and director of Project Damocles, an international effort to find a cure for radiation poisoning. When he was approached by goons working for Harold Meachum who offered him money in exchange for full rights to the cure, he refused and was severely beaten. He was knocked into radioactive isotopes and became an inhuman being capable of generating nuclear blasts, calling himself Radion. Looking for help in controlling the radiation, he sought the assistance of the Puppet Master and helped him against in a fight pitting Thor against the Fantastic Four. He next appeared in London, destroying an airplane coming in from the US that carried Iron Fist and Misty Knight as passengers, in an attempt to blackmail the British government into giving him nuclear materials he needed. henri desire landru.origin: A variation of Henri-Désiré Landru from Earth-1218 whose life was closely mirrored by his Earth-616 counterpart. Henri-Désiré Landru (April 12, 1869 to February 23 or 25, 1922) was a French serial killer and real-life “Bluebeard”, born in Paris in 1869 and ultimately died -- executed for a multitude of murders, the exact number of which is unknown -- in February of 1922. thumb|250px|left In the mainstream Marvel Universe, however, Landru somehow escaped this fate -- or was brought back to life afterwards -- and took up residence in the Bazaar at the End of Unreason, owning and operating a shop that traded in skulls with mystic properties. It was in this profession that he had at least one encounter with Doctor Strange, and met him once again when the Sorcerer Supreme was accompanied by Augustyne Phyffe, who had the odd experience of having a conversation with the skull of his own father, which was among Landru's stock. Landru's current whereabouts and activities are unknown.

henrietta hunter.name: Henrietta Hunter
henrietta hunter.origin: ===Origins and Death=== When Henrietta Hunter was a young girl, she dreamed of becoming famous. As she grew up, she became Europa's hottest young pop star, until she was electrocuted and killed by a microphone that someone had sabotaged. ===Resurrection and X-Statix=== Henrietta's ghostly spirit returned to Hawthorne House, the ancestral home of the Hunters. Her spirit levitated towards her body and re-possessed it, resurrecting her with a happy "ta-da!" X-Statix eventually arrived and saved her from the European government agents, who had recently arrived to make sure Henrietta stayed dead. Upon saving her, X-Statix returned to their HQ in Santa Monica, California, where Henrietta revealed that she was a mutant, gifted with empathy. Soon after her return, she appeared on "Lacuna & the Stars" to announce her comeback. After her show, Henrietta met with Spike Freeman in Los Angeles, California to discuss the merchandising of her name, where she was attacked by an assassin hired by European agents Dicky and Reggie. The assassin's plot was foiled by Doop and Spike Freeman then announced on television that Henrietta was joining X-Statix. To announce her membership, X-Statix appeared in New York with a red carpet arrival. While in New York City, Henrietta was attacked and kidnapped by the Euro-Trash, a group made up entirely of national stereotypes. Euro-Trash retreated to an X-Statix Store in New York, while X-Statix fought with themselves over whether or not to save her. They eventually decided to save her and they teleported inside the store and killed all the members of Euro-Trash. After saving Henrietta, X-Statix held a press conference, where Henrietta revealed many of her charitable ideas. Later, Henrietta visited young Jesus Diaz at the hospital, whose legs had been amputated due to a landmine. Upon seeing her charitable spree (with their money), X-Statix decided that they must kill her. Henrietta relaxed aboard a yacht, when X-Statix appeared. Lacuna tagged along on Venus Dee Milo's teleportational coattails and warned Henrietta that they were there to kill her. She then convinced X-Statix to rethink the idea of killing Henrietta and they decided against it. Henrietta later joined X-Statix on a mission to Afghanistan, where she took out several members of a Taliban sect. When they returned to Santa Monica, X-Statix held a press conference, where Henrietta was announced the new team leader and United States Secretary of Homeland Defense. After a modeling shoot involving her designs, Henrietta led X-Statix on a wild goose chase in an attempt to locate Mister Code, a mastermind responsible for various random sniper killings. Not having any luck finding him, Henrietta returned to the X-Statix HQ and used her abilities to communicate with ghostly spirits to aid her in throwing a dart to Mister Code's location on a giant map of the United States. As she asked for help from the spirits, Dead Girl also spoke with the deceased in an attempt to throw Henrietta off course and further ruin Ms. Hunter's image. When Henrietta appeared on television, she was pelted with fruit and other trash, due to her faltering public image associated with her failure to locate the random killer. Henrietta led X-Statix as they broke into Lacuna's lawyers' offices to retrieve the incriminating evidence against them. Unfortunately, her lawyer had turned the evidence over to the press, ruining X-Statix's image. In order to fix their image, X-Statix decided that they had to stop Mister Code. Determining his location thanks to Dead Girl communicating with Spike Freeman's corpse, Venus teleported X-Statix into battle against Mister Code. During the battle, Mister Code kills Phat and breaks Henrietta's neck. He himself is killed by the Orphan. After Henrietta's second death, her record company released a single entitled “Back from the Dead,” which mysteriously killed anyone who sang the song aloud. A young boy named Jamie sang the song and was killed almost instantly after singing it. Also, a man named Chester and his son Ethan were both killed after singing the song. Following the funeral of X-Statix member Phat, another X-Statix member, El Guapo, sang the song and briefly saw the reanimated corpse of Henrietta, causing him to fly his skateboard off course, crash into a plate glass window, and impale himself on his own board. In order to get to the bottom of the deaths caused by Henrietta's single, X-Statix had Dead Girl sing the song. She was instantly destroyed and as she was reforming herself, she too saw Henrietta's corpse. After speaking a bit with Henrietta's corpse, Dead Girl discovered that Henrietta was taking her revenge on those who wanted her dead by killing any who sung her song aloud. X-Statix decided to travel to Europa and confront the president of Europa. They then forced the president to sing her song. As he did, Henrietta's form once again reappeared and X-Statix left the president to Henrietta's wrath. While in battle,

henrik weber.name: Henrik Weber
henrik weber.origin: Henrik Weber was a sixteen-year-old boy who lived in Winzeldorf, Germany. A short time ago, Henrik became romantically attached to a Romani girl named Trista. Any chance of a relationship between the two however was dashed when Trista caught Henrik in the arms of another woman. Overwrought with guilt, Henrik went to Trista's home to apologize to her family for his slight, her unforgiving grandmother placed a curse upon him, transforming him into a rage-filled monster. Henrik's own father, weak of heart, was so shocked at seeing his son's transformation that he died on the spot. Rumors of the creature's existence began to circulate throughout Winzeldorf and the villagers began to refer to him as Vielfras. The villagers did not know that the Vielfras was actually Henrik and they blamed him for the death of Henrik Weber and his father, as well as two missing children. Through the aid of a woman named Mara Keller, the people of Winzeldorf enlisted the aid of the X-Man and former resident of Winzeldorf, Nightcrawler, to rid the town of this creature. Nightcrawler first battled the Vielfras at Mara Keller's Nightcrawler Museum. The two traded sword blows and Nightcrawler chased him into the nearby forests. Tracking him down, he learned that the Vielfras was just a young boy who had never actually hurt anyone. Nightcrawler sympathized with him, reflecting upon his own mistreatment at the hands of town villagers many years ago. The townsfolk caught up to them and attacked both Nightcrawler and Vielfras. They fought back and Nightcrawler was incapacitated by a shotgun blast to the shoulder. Vielfras defeated his attackers, but could no longer endure this monstrous lifestyle. Picking up one of the stray shotguns, he took his own life. For reasons that remain unclear, the demon lord Mephisto appeared on the scene to collect Weber's soul as well as the souls of the twelve dead men whom Weber had killed while defending himself.

henrique gallante.name: Henrique Gallante
henrique gallante.origin: ===Origin=== Born with Fetal Alcohol Syndrome, Henrique Gallante was raised in an abusive home. Constantly mistreated and abused, he turned inward, becoming one with his own mental darkness. As he aged, he turned to drugs to try to kill the pain he felt he was in. He spent much of his youth struggling with his drug dependency. This dependency eventually caused him to snap and manifest his own internal darkness in a physical form by unconsciously tapping into the Darkforce dimension. Reveling in this manifestation, Gallante used his powers as often as he felt like it, eventually becoming one with the darkness, giving into his darkest desires and wrapping his physical form in the Darkforce energy. thumb|160px|left ===Darkling=== Eventually, the constant abuse of his powers caused Gallante's powers to erupt in New York and he became Darkling, washing over everyone and bringing out their darkest desires while physically covering them with Darkforce energy. This eruption of dark energies caused the city's heroes (most notably the New Warriors, Fantastic Four, Cloak, Dagger, Spider-Man, Avengers, and Archangel) to band together to try and stop him. Battling the villain, many of the heroes fell to him, becoming encased in Darkforce energy and succumbing to their dark feelings (Cloak and Silhouette were exceptionally susceptible because of their Darkforce-based powers). A number of the heroes managed to remain in control of themselves (most notably Dagger and Firestar, whose powers proved most effective against Gallante) and fought against Gallante. Eventually, by showing him that his actions were just as bad as the people who had abused him, Gallante briefly attained a moment of clarity, then snapped. Gallante reclaimed all of the Darkforce energy he had released and collapsed upon himself into the Darkforce dimension. ===Asylum=== Gallante eventually returned from the Darkforce dimension and took on the new identity of Asylum. He recruited Psionex, the original Asylum's former teammates, to fight with him as street-level vigilantes. During one of their patrols, however, Psionex saw what appeared to be a group of kids threatening each other with guns. When Asylum attacked the "punks", he swallowed one up in his trauma-inducing Darkforce before Impulse realized they were just squirt guns. Asylum's victim had a pre-existing medical condition which caused him to die as a result of Gallante's Darkforce assault. Asylum fled prosecution, but was eventually brought in by Night Thrasher and the New Warriors to answer for the boy's death. ===After M-Day=== Henrique retained his powers after M-Day, and was found by the Thunderbolts (Mach-IV, Blizzard, and Fixer) in the Wiley Institute for Debilitative Mental Health in the Bronx, seemingly unstable. Fixer managed to make Gallante open a Darkforce portal for the Thunderbolts to travel through the Darkforce dimension and bring back Blackout (Marcus Daniels), and was seemingly recruited. His current whereabouts are unknown.

henry buchanan.name: Henry Buchanan
henry buchanan.origin: Dr. Henry Buchanan was a leading scientist working for Singularity Investigations to develop a modified Legacy Virus to target former mutants. However, Dr. Buchanan's consciousness finally overcame his nerves and he decided to try to expose S.I. To do this, Dr. Buchanan enlisted the aid of Jamie Madrox and X-Factor Investigations. Madrox sent Strong Guy to accompany Dr. Buchanan to his safety deposit box to retrieve the evidence of S.I.'s research. Unfortunately, S.I. had previously brainwashed Strong Guy and activated him to kill Dr. Buchanan. After Strong Guy was deprogrammed, he was able to anonymously inform the police to the whereabouts of Dr. Buchanan's body.

henry carter.name: Henry Carter
henry carter.origin: Henry "Whirlwind" Carter was a native of Earth-5464, a distant alternate future where humanity had expanded across the solar system and established colonies, including one on Venus. Not much is known about Carter's life, but he became an operative of the Interplanetary Secret Service (ISS), stationed on Venus. In his first recorded adventure, Carter detected an Earth ship under attack by Martians and rescued its pilot, Brenda Hale, an agent of the newly-formed Space Army. Hale revealed that the Martians were planning a massive invasion of Earth: conquering its cities, capturing the human population, and launching them into space inside rockets to replace them with Martian settlers. Rallying forces from the Venusian ISS, Carter and Hale launched a counterattack. They rescued the captured Earthlings, regrouped them on Venus, and returned with an improvised army equipped with elastic-gas bombs. With this weapon, Carter forced the Martians out of New York, their headquarters on Earth, and ultimately drove them back to their homeworld. For his victory and for liberating Earth, Carter was promoted by his superiors in the ISS, taking on the added responsibility of protecting Earth as part of his interplanetary duties. . Later, Carter would come to the Earth's defense again, this time against the alien Black Light Men who would also attempt to remove the Earth and sell it to the Martians. Their plot would involve moving the Earth out of its orbit to lower its temperature. Whatever humans would not be wiped out by the cold would be lifted off the planet by a gravity ray of their own devising. Their entire operation would be carried out by their orbital planet. Learning of this plot, Carter would seek the aid of defenses from both Earth and Venus. Storming the Black Light Planet, Carter and his men would be fighting the Black Light People to a standstill. It would not be until Brenda Hale would learn that the creatures feared fire that they won a victory, chasing the Black Light People off a cliff and sending their planet on a chaotic orbit. Although millions of humans were killed as a result of the Black Light Peoples attack, the Earth was once more saved by Whirlwind Carter . Whirlwinds subsequent activities are unrevealed.
abilities: Whirlwind Carter was a superb fighter, rocket pilot
weapons: Whirlwind uses ray guns as needed.
