herr hitzig construct.name: Herr Hitzig (Construct)
herr hitzig construct.origin: This construct based on the Nazi soldier Herr Hitzig was accidentally unleashed by a mutant named Amy, whose powers allowed her to create imaginary constructs in reality, and they had been heavily damaged as the result of her traumatic experience in the Red Skull's Genoshan concentration camps. The construct appeared as the result of Magneto's memories interacting with Amy's powers. The construct proceeded to murder numerous innocent mutants in Genosha once Magneto started transforming the island into a mutant sanctuary once again, and left a swastika painted at the scene of one of his crimes. He also used his morphing abilities to infiltrated Magneto's base and paint his mirror with blood. Magneto investigated the murders and encountered the construct. After a failed attempt to kill Hitzig, the construct escaped through the sewers. Magneto realized the cause of the monster's presence, and confronted his accidental creator. Meanwhile, Hitzig attacked Magneto's lover, Briar Raleigh, and was about to murder her when Magneto killed Amy, causing the construct to dissolve.
powers: Constituent- : This construct of Herr Hitzig is capable of morphing its body to a liquid-like red substance, he can morph his arms into tentacles, and use them for offense.

herr horner.name: Herr Horner
herr horner.origin: Herr Horner was a high ranking Nazi official during World War II. In the spring of 1941, Horner pretended to defect from Nazi Germany, arriving in the United Kingdom and asking to see Lord Danvers. In reality, he sought to capture Danvers and bring him back to Germany, as a way of silencing the British publisher from printing anymore anti-Nazi material. Invited into Danvers' home, Horner snuck his colleague, Gestapo agent Cramm into Danvers' home. Spotted by Headline Hunter, he attempted to stop their plot. Knocking the reporter out. they captured Danvers and attempted to take him back to Germany. Hunter caught up to the two German spies and knocked them out until military police could arrive and arrest them. They were to be incarcerated in the Tower of London. Horners' fate following World War II is unrecorded.
weapons: Horner was armed with a Luger.

herr huss.name: Herr Huss
herr huss.origin: Herr Huss was a high ranking Nazi official in Nazi Germany during World War II. In 1941, he pretended to defect from the Nazis and fled to the United States for the purposes of trying to free Germany from Nazi rule. Flying to New Jersey to meet with his American contact, the millionaire John Garrett, he ended up in a dog fight and was shot down by the American costumed hero known as the Patriot. Confronting Huss, the Patriot was sold by his story and took him to Garrett's mansion. There, the Patriot attempted to call his friend, newspaper reporter Jack Casey to give him the story only to be shot by Garrett's butler. Casey went to Garrett's home and overheard Huss and Garret's true intentions: to lull the United States into being open to a blitzkrieg attack from Nazi forces. Casey accidentally fell through a skylight and was captured by the two Nazis who sealed him behind a brick wall in the basement of the mansion. The Patriot revived and found his friend's hat. He confronted Huss and Garrett about it, and the two attempted to kill him as well. In the fight, Huss accidentally shot Garrett, killing him. Seeking to avoid capture, Huss chose to commit suicide, turning his own gun on himself.
abilities: Huss was a trained soldier and fighter pilot.
weapons: Huss was armed with a pistol.

herr kameleon.name: Herr Kameleon
herr kameleon.origin: Herr Kameleon was a Nazi agent under the command of Rathcone during World War II. Rathcone's assignment was to eliminate high ranking officials within the United States military, including Captain America and Bucky. It is Herr Kameleon and another agent codenamed the Strangler who are tasked with capturing the two heroes. They managed to capture Bucky and used him as bait to attract Captain America before killing him. When Captain America shows up, however, the duo are able to defeat Rathcone and his agents, leaving them for the F.B.I.. Herr Kameleon's subsequent activities are as yet unrevealed.

herr klutz.name: Herr Klutz
herr klutz.origin: Herr Klutz was a member of the Nazis who was active during World War II. By December 1943 he was successfully posing as Captain Landis of the United States Army and using this position to learn secrets of the Allied Forces defending the Russian front. With the assistant of his fellow spies Stephanie and Weasel Face they relayed information to their commanding officer General Von Bock, who managed to heavily fortify himself in Russia. Unfortunately for Klutz and his subordinates, the Human Torch and Toro were called in to assist the Allies. Spotting Stephanie and "Landis" acting suspicious they learned their true identities and were captured by Klutz's men who were wearing asbestos lined suits. The agents had the Torch and Toro placed under a press that would apply more pressure on them with each passing minute. However, they made the mistake of leaving before their ultimate doom to go assist in foiling the Allied attack on Von Brock's stronghold, allowing the two heroes to escape. When Stephanie and the other agents returned to witness the end of Toro and Torch were arrested by military police. The Torch and Toro helped foil Klutz's plot and sent Klutz and Weasel-Face's plane crashing into one of the main Goering Works weapons manufacturing plants built by the Nazis, killing them in a massive explosion.

herr kopf.name: Herr Kopf
herr kopf.origin: Herr Kopf was a Kapitan in the Wehrmacht, who was tasked with the mission to construct an undersea tunnel. In the February of 1941, Herr Kopf was tasked by his superiors to construct an undersea tunnel from France to England. He inspected the plans at his office, when in the meanwhile the plan was discovered by Lynne Harris, resulting into the tunnel getting destroyed by the Sub-Mariner in the aftermath. He was taken as a prisoner of war and seemingly brought to a P.O.W. camp in Canada, where he escaped due to Herr Schnapps' help. After the Sub-Mariner discovered him and the rest of the prisoners under the deck, he instigated a mutiny against Herr Schnapps and a captain. Unfortunately, Herr Kopf recognized the Sub-Mariner and alerted his men, ending the mutiny as a result. In the end, he, along with the rest of the Nazis, were defeated and brought back to the P.O.W. camp.

herr mongrel.name: Herr Mongrel
herr mongrel.origin: Herr Mongrel was a Nazi spy active during World War II. During the fall of 1942, he and his minions were located in New York City and decided to demoralize Americans by preventing food supplies from reaching New York City. Although they were initially successful, they were opposed by the Fighting Fool and his partner Napoleon Sack who attacked them while they attempted to sink a supply ship docked at New York Harbor. The Fighting Fool and Napoleon defeated his gang and then sent a speeding car full of explosives at Herr Mongrel. Herr Mongrel was too slow to get out of the way and was killed in the resulting explosion.
weapons: Herr Mongrel had access to fire arms and explosives.

herr radder.name: Herr Radder
herr radder.origin: Herr Radder was a Nazi spy active during World War II. Stationed in New York City in the fall of 1943, he and his agents began moving the illuminated markers around a reef near a port in order to sink American ships returning to the States. After the fourth sinking, the Sub-Mariner was called in to investigate. While he prevented another sinking, the Nazi spies got away in the process. Later, when Herr Radder read in the newspaper that the Sub-Mariner had a lead on where the Nazis were hiding out, Radder and his men set up a trap for the hero. Having one of his men pose as an injured man, Radder and his men got the drop on Namor, hitting him over the head with a typewriter and taking the seemingly unconscious Atlantean to their hideout to be disposed of. This however, as all part of Namor's plan, who was playing possum the whole time. At the Nazis' hideout, Namor sprung into action, subduing Radder's minions. Radder fled during the fight and tried to escape in a speedboat, however Namor caught up to him. Knocking Radder out, Namor wrecked the rudder on his boat and jumped ship. When Radder came around, he thought he had defeated the Sub-Mariner and attempted to continue his escape when he realized he could no longer steer his boat. Radder's boat then drove into a minefield, and he was killed in the explosion.

Radder fled during the fight and tried to escape in a speedboat, however Namor caught up to him. Knocking Radder out, Namor wrecked the rudder on his boat and jumped ship. When Radder came around, he thought he had defeated the Sub-Mariner and attempted to continue his escape when he realized he could no longer steer his boat. Radder's boat then drove into a minefield, and he was killed in the explosion.

herr schmutz.name: Herr Schmutz
herr schmutz.origin: Herr Schmutz was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In the early days of 1944, he and his minions began tainting blood donated to the Red Cross from American citizens to be used in war hospitals in Europe. To this end, they set up a secret hideout along the shipping route and planted their agents as truckers. When the shipments passed inspection, the supplies of blood were driven to the hideout and then replaced with previously obtained samples that had been poisoned. When American troops injured during combat in Italy were given the tainted blood as transfusions and killed, the military allowed the Human Torch and Toro to investigate stateside to see what they could learn. Discovering the secret operation, the Torch sent Toro to get the FBI while he tried to round-up Schmutz and his men. Schmutz coated the Torch in flame-retarding chemicals that hardened into a shell around his body and took him prisoner. Fleeing back to a Nazi U-Boat waiting to take him back to Nazi Germany, Schmutz and his minions were opposed by Toro, who forced them to crash their car. Able to free his companion, Toro and the Torch prevented Schmutz and the U-Boat crew from escaping and turned them over to the authorities. Schmutz's subsequent fate is unknown.

herr schnapps.name: Herr Schnapps
herr schnapps.origin: Herr Schnapps was a German intelligence agent during the second World War. In the summer of 1941, Schnapps held a meeting in which they discussed about the freeing of German P.O.W.'s. Schnapps raised the idea to hire a ship captain who would transport the prisoners back to Germany. Later that day, Schnapps drove in hurry to the prison to accompany the captain, until he was stopped by the Sub-Mariner, who advised him to drive safely, due to the many car- and shipaccidents in the last time. Now accompanied by the Sub-Mariner he drove to his ship where he and his men entered the ship together with the Sub-Mariner. Schnapps was then taken prisoner himself, after the Sub-Mariner found the German P.O.W. under the deck, defeated the captain, and freed the prisoners who became mutinous. He was later freed, after one of the Nazi P.O.W.'s recognised the Sub-Mariner from an other adventure and told his comrades about it. Laughing and thinking that the Sub-Mariner had no chance against the wrath of the P.O.W.'s, he was, along with the captain, finally defeated. Herrn Schnapps' fate following the war is unknown.

herr schnitzel.name: Herr Schnitzel
herr schnitzel.origin: Herr Schnitzel was a German American who was a member of the German-American Federation (better known as the Bund), a pro-Nazi political group in pre-war America. He belonged to a Bund that operated out of Camp Reichland and had a reputation for intimidating other German Americans into joining them, for which they were opposed by Captain America. Retreating to a cabin in the woods, he spoke with a confederate about the Captain's interference in their fifth column activities, which was overheard by Bucky, as was their plans for revenge. Presumably, he was arrested after Cap and Bucky foiled a terrorist plot by the Bund in preparation for an invasion of America.

herr snupp.name: Herr Snupp
herr snupp.origin: Herr Snupp was a Nazi sent to the United States to lead the Unholy Legion, a group of spies to undermine the U.S. war effort. He and his minions disguised themselves as homeless people and panhandled to fund their efforts. After assassinating a few individuals, Snupp and his minions were spotted by Captain America and Bucky while in their civilian disguises as Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes. Barnes was sent by Rogers to investigate the strange group but was captured. He was eventually saved by Rogers. While the pair captured Snupp's men, Snupp fled the scene and tried to escape via a hidden Nazi U-Boat. Rogers and Bucky boarded the sub, however, and forced to Snupp to flee it. Snupp freed his minions and fought Rogers and Bucky again. Snupp and his men were eventually defeated by Rogers and Bucky and turned over to the authorities. His current whereabouts are unknown.

herr swastika.name: Herr Swastika
herr swastika.origin: The man known as Herr Swastika was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In 1945 he and a group of other spies built a secret hideout in the Great Lakes region near Niagara Falls. They constructed small one-man submarines one-man submarines that were disguised as turtles and used them to commit acts of sabotage, mostly targeting freighters bringing ore mined from Canada down to the United States. The attacks left the authorities baffled and the Sub-Mariner was called in to help figure out how the spies were destroying the ships. Namor discovered two of the turtle subs and destroyed them, their crew members killing themselves before they could be questioned. Running across his friend Betty Dean (who coincidentally was hunting in the area) the pair were spotted by Herr Swastika and his men. They eventually captured the pair and locked them up in a cell away from water so that Namor would dehydrate. Herr Swastika then left his prisoners in order to lead an army of turtle subs to attack the water purification facility located at Niagara Falls. Namor and Betty managed to break out of their cell and follow after Herr Swastika and his men. Destroying the subs, Namor captured Herr Swastika and turned him over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

herr von richter.name: Herr Von Richter
herr von richter.origin: Herr Von Richter was a member of the Nazis during World War II. So devoted to the Nazi regime, he took to fashioning his appearance to resemble that of Nazi leader Adolf Hitler. In the spring of 1943, he led a group of spies in New York City. They attempted to wreck the American economy by planting bombs in the city's largest banks. To this end, they purchased safety deposit boxes that would explode after they left, destroying the banks and killing staff and customers alike. The hope was to drive Americans to pull all their money out of the banks and avoid them. After their fourth successful operation, their activities attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who then staked out the Fifth National Bank, the next likely target. Sure enough, Von Richter and his men appeared at the bank and attempted to plant their bombs. The Torch, posing as a security guard, identified them by recognizing the hand writing on the application to match that of applications signed at the previous banks. As the Torch and Toro rounded up Von Richter's men, the Nazi spy attempted to flee the scene before his bomb went off. The Human Torch freed the bomb and tossed it at Von Richter's get away car. The bomb then exploded, killing Von Richter in the process.

herr wolf.name: Herr Wolf
herr wolf.origin: Herr Wolf was a Nazi spy active during World War II. In the fall of 1943, he and his minions were stationed out of New York City and were to be in receipt of a new Nazi weapon called "War Water", a highly incendiary fluid that the Nazis used with success on the Russian front. The formula was to be smuggled into the United States by Kaspar Gregg, a Swedish athlete whose parents were placed in a Nazi concentration camp and their continued living was dependent on his compliance. Although the Human Torch and Toro attempted to stop the transfer of the formula to Wolf and his men. Learning that they were operating out of the Wolf Chemical Plant, the Human Torch and Toro arrived just as Wolf and his minions had finished completing their first batch of the War Water. They knocked the hero and fled the scene to use the fluid to destroy the George Washington Bridge. The Human Torch and Toro however managed to round them up for the authorities and destroy their supply of War Water. Herr Wolf's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Herr Wolf briefly had access to "War Water", a chemical compound created by Nazi scientist. It was highly flammable. It was certainly a precursor to napalm which was not first used in warfare until 1944.

hescamar.origin: Marnot arrived in Hel, with the purpose of freeing Thor from Hela's embrace, so that he could atone for the mortal Jake Olson's death. He revived Thor, and gave him the mortal form and semblance of Jake Olson, but because he could not revive the dead, it was not the true Jake Olson, so Thor did not have his memories or knowledge. Taurey told him he was seeking revenge on Steve Rogers, whose Continental Army ancestor killed Taurey's ancestor in a duel after Taurey tried to warn the British of George Washington's approach . As Captain America and the federal forces stormed Taurey's estate, Heshin was arrested along with the rest of the Elite .

hexadecimal.name: Hexadecimal
hexadecimal.origin: Hexadecimal was a member of the Raksha, a team of ruthless mutant vigilantes operating in Madripoor. They were inspired by Wolverine, whom they knew as Patch from his time in their country. While brutally taking down a MGH delaer, the Raksha were interrupted by Jimmy Hudson, who disapproved the lethality of their methods. The Raksha's leader Norio attacked Jimmy, but was soon subdued by his teammate from the X-Men, Marvel Girl, who arried to assist Jimmy together with Beast. The X-Men and the Raksha engaged in a fight, during which Hexadecimal attacked Jimmy with the motor of a car. The conflict was abruptly stopped by Norio himself once Jimmy popped his claws and Norio recognized their similarity to Wolverine's. After clearing up their intentions, both teams agreed to work together. When the young X-Men's Madripoor X-Mansion was attacked by the Goblin Queen and her Hex-Men, Marvel Girl and Cyclops sought the Raksha's help. Together, they interrupted the Goblin Queen's magic ritual to summon her counterparts from other realities. After the villainess' defeat, Magneto offered the Raksha to bring them under his wing, but they refused since they believed Wolverine wouldn't approve them following his tutelage. During the beginning of the Mothervine crisis, the Raksha encountered a group of Hellfire Club henchmen. They infiltrated the X-Mansion to inform Magneto about their presence in Madripoor, as well as to check up on the X-Men, since they were concerned they had been compromised after hearing nothing from them for weeks. At the time, the time-displaced members of the young X-Men were off-world due to an emergency mission in space. The Raksha remained at the X-Mansion under Polaris' observation, but she fell under the control of the psychic entity Malice and attacked them. Polaris managed to fight off Malice's possession, but not before having brutalized all of the Raksha except Gazing Nightshade. Her teammates were hospitalized at the X-Man's infirmary afterwards, and Nightshade herself temporarily joined Polaris' makeshift roster of X-Men to help stop the spread of the Mothervine. Having recovered, the Raksha teamed up with the X-Men to take down a group of ninja MGH dealers. Since Magneto had returned to his mutant-supremacist roots and the time-displaced X-Men were preparing to return to their era, the young mutants arranged with Polaris and Danger to offer the Raksha the opportunity to become their students at the X-Mansion. The Raksha were initially reluctant, but seemed to take up the offer.

hhurr.name: Hhurr
hhurr.origin: Hhurr was an an animal bred by a Cotati general and trained for war on Plonn. This made it a rarity among the Cotati who hated animals, as it stayed with them even after they decided to destroy animal life. Its master deeply loved it, letting it eat from the other animals he killed. When the general learned of the destruction of the Cotati caused on the Blue Area of the Moon by a mutant, he decided to invade Krakoa with his forces. Hhurr accompanied him, but was killed in the battle by Magneto.

hhvx.name: HHVX
hhvx.origin: After the disappearance of Magneto, the Brotherhood of Mutant Supremacy fell into the control of his children, Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch. The siblings created a sort of truce with Professor Xavier of the X-Men, whereby they would attempt to minimize the loss of human life in their attacks and instead focus on revealing and neutralizing corruption or the potential for devastation. On one such mission to Pakistan, they attacked a nuclear missile facility alongside HHVX and numerous other mutants. While Scarlet Witch and the Animal Evolutionaries assaulted the base's defenses, Quicksilver and HHVX infiltrated the base itself. HHVX infected the Pakistani computers and paralyzed the missiles' launch pads, allowing Scarlet Witch to levitate the weapons away. At the same time, another Brotherhood team did the same in India, thereby eliminated the threat of nuclear war in the region.
powers: A self-replicating virus, able to infect, control, or damage both living beings and electronics.

fields.unusual_features: Takes the form of enlarged and numerous glowing viral strands.

hiari.name: Hiari
hiari.origin: Hiari was an elder of the village Uzuri in Kenya. She welcomed Ororo Munroe when she returned as soon as she learned that her foster mother Ainet Mwangi had passed away. Hiari lied about Ainet having died in her sleep due to old age, and hushed Ororo when she expressed worry about the emergence of a new local religion that worshipped Uovu. The night after taking Ororo to Ainet's grave, Hiari agreed to take her to meet Uovu in person.

hiawatha smith.origin: Hiawatha Smith was the son of a heroic chief of the Native American nations that also fought against the Axis Powers during World War II. His father passed down to his son the mystic knowledge of their people and a map leading to a vast Nazi treasure of wealth and advanced technology sought by the Red Skull. hideko togu.name: Hideko Togu
hideko togu.origin: thumb|left|Doctor Togu's human form The sinister Dr. Togu was a biologist loyal to Imperial Japan during World War II and helped create a series of biological weapons. A number of these weapons were deployed against the Chinese resistance in the summer of 1942. Soon, Togu managed to synthesize what he claimed was the chemical source of vampirism. With this solution, Togu smuggled himself into the United States and used the serum on himself. Transforming into a bat-like creature, Togu -- now calling himself the Vampire -- targeted high ranking military officials stationed at Camp Lehigh. This lead to a number of clashes with Captain America and Bucky. Despite the heroes' interference, he succeeded in exsanguinating two military officials before fleeing into a nearby castle. Reverting to human form, he tricked Captain America and Bucky into believing that he was the owner of the property in order to get their guard down. Transforming back into the Vampire, Togu attacked the heroes again. During the fight, the Vampire was pushed towards an open window as the sun was coming up, and it caused him to transform back to human form. In mid-air while this transformation occurred, Tongu suffered a fatal fall, cursing the two heroes before he died.
powers: As the Vampire, Tongu had large leather wings allowing him to . He was capable of carrying at least one full grown male, presuming some . He had sharp fangs that allowed him to pierce into the throats of his victims and drink their blood.
abilities: Doctor Togu was a skilled scientist who plied his trade to creating biological weapons.
weaknesses: Exposure to sunlight caused the Vampire to revert back to human form.

hieronymus hellgore.name: Hieronymus Hellgore
hieronymus hellgore.origin: Hieronymus Hellgore was a scientist living in a dimension where such practise was prohibited, and people were to devote purely to magic instead. After showing the elders of his dimension his work, Hieronymus was persecuted by the Blood Monks. Hieronymus planned on escaping along with his wife Abbadona and his son. However, the Blood Monks caught up with them before they could board their ship. Hieronymus sacrificed himself so Abbadona and the child could escape. Abbadona would later do the same, leaving the child orphan. Fueled by the death of his parents, their son became the Imperator, and embarked in a journey to eradicate magic and magic users from every dimension.

high priest.name: High Priest
high priest.origin: thumb|left|200px The man known as the High Priest that served Princess Anjulie was once the ruler of Earth and the father of Kymri. When the society climbing witch named Anjulie came to the court of the King, she used her magic to entice the King and to coerce him into asking for her to marry him. Once they were wed, she forced her step-daughter Kymri from the city and began to rule the planet with an iron fist, forcing the king into the role of the High Priest. As the High Priest, Anjulie used her magic on him to disfigure and weaken him both physically and mentally until he was completely under her command. Thinking her father was dead, Kymri became the one person in the whole world that Anjulie feared and began a rebellion against her rule. Some time later, the group known as Excalibur arrived on their world, the man known as Nightcrawler single-handedly defeated her forces in battle, saving Anjulie's life in the process. Realizing too late, that he aided the wrong side in the conflict, Nightcrawler aids Kymri against Anjulie and her High Priest to save the other members of his team. During the conflict, Kymri slays the High Priest only to discover too late that he was her father.

high technician.name: High Technician
high technician.origin: High Technician was once a student of The High Evolutionary who worked out of the High Evolutionary's abandoned base in the Savage Land, experimenting on dinosaurs. At some point, The High Technician worked with A.I.M., who provided power to his base in exchange for mining rights. The base was discovered by Falcon, and the High Technician captured Falcon by using Lorelei to mind control him. Showing Falcon around the base he revealed his experiment to convert dinosaurs into a humanoid form, and had sent them out to capture Captain America. However the High Technician feared their failure and sent out the Falcon to lure him to the base to mind control him as well. However, after they arrived at the base it was revealed the Falcon had never been under the High Technician's control and Falcon knocked him out as Terminus arrived. The Saur Lords attempted to protect the High Technician from Terminus. However they failed and Terminus brought the High Technician to other AIM agents, who planned to sedate him. Captain America was sure that the High Technician would never work with AIM again after their betrayal. Black Panther didn't like the idea of making a deal with the High Technician and stayed behind to help the Savage Land.

highcloud.name: Highcloud
highcloud.origin: Highcloud was a member of the Keewazi. When the tribe's government entered in an agreement with Roxxon to let them drill their land, Highcloud supported the action as an investment on their community, putting him at odds with a faction of tribe members who pushed back against Roxxon's intervention. The perforation disturbed a maze of subterranean passages where a collective of Moloids lived. The Moloids attacked the surface, but Keewazi leader Wyatt Wingfoot managed to defuse the situation. After making amends, the Keewazi welcomed the Moloids into their tribe. The Moloids coexisted on the surface for a week until the Mole Man became aware of their mingling with the Keewazi and threatened them to return underground. In response, Wyatt signaled the Fantastic Four, but the call was only heeded by the Human Torch and his partner Sky. A day after issuing the warning, the Mole Man attacked Silver Rock Springs with a group of dinosaurs. A fight broke out until Sky used her powers to explain to the Mole Man's dinosaurs that their master was in the wrong, putting an abrupt end to his intrusion.

higher evolutionary.name: Higher Evolutionary
higher evolutionary.species: Lifeform created by the High Evolutionary using his own genetic material to create a superior being
higher evolutionary.origin: The Higher Evolutionary was created by the High Evolutionary using his own genetic material in order to create something better than his New Men. However, the Higher Evolutionary possessed compassion, something his creator considered a flaw. The Higher Evolutionary also cared for the New Men that inhabited Counter-Earth. When the High Evolutionary planned to eliminate the New Men, the Higher Evolutionary objected. The High Evolutionary punished his creation by hooking him up to the Orbit-Engine, which regulated Counter-Earth's orbit positioned many miles underground; if he removed himself from the machine, Counter-Earth would be destroyed. So, the Higher Evolutionary chose to remain in the Orbit Engine so the New Men he cared about didn't perish. The Avengers and Champions went into the chamber where the Orbit-Engine was to prevent the High Evolutionary's mad plan to collide Earth with Counter-Earth. While the two teams held off a team of New Men that guarded the way toward the Orbit-Engine, Vision's daughter Viv of the Champions snuck off and found the Orbit-Engine and the Higher Evolutionary. The Higher Evolutionary explained his origins and the reason why he was connected to the Orbit-Engine. Viv was able to convince the Higher Evolutionary to remove himself for the Orbit-Engine and stop it so both of their worlds weren't destroyed. He told Viv that only she was resilient enough to get close enough to the machine to turn it off. When the Avengers and Champions arrived, the Higher Evolutionary accused Viv of lying to him and attacked her allies. So, Viv chose to deactivate the machine by sacrificing herself to do that, foiling the High Evolutionary's plan.
weaknesses: The Higher Evolutionary is not very trusting of outsiders and will attack them if he views them as a threat.

highlander.name: Highlander
highlander.origin: The Highlander is a member of the team of super-heroes sponsored by the Irish government called the Kinsmen. They were considered Ireland's answer to the Avengers. The Highlander itself seemed to be a mass on semi-sentient Irish soil brought to life through unknown means. The Kinsmen were sent to Cassidy Keep to collect Sean Cassidy in the early morning hours for a long overdue debriefing by officials of the Irish government. However, the team discovered that he was not home, but they were greeted by his daughter, Theresa, and the Seneschal, Eamon O'Donnell. The team were brusk in their conversations with Theresa, demanding to know where her father was to the point a fight broke out between her and the Kinsmen. Teleplex, who had remained in the helicopter with their government liaison, Mr. McFadden, monitored their situation inside Cassidy Keep. At some point Teleplex's remote viewing of the situation was interrupted until Highlander came flying through the air out of Cassidy Keep. At this point Highlander wanted to retire from the battle as it seemed to be damaged. Moments later the rest of the team also left the building as they were unable to defeat the young mutant. Soon the angry Irishwoman took the defeated team to Mr. McFadden and Teleplex, telling them to leave her and her father alone and call first before they ever return to Cassidy Keep. Mr. McFadden cried when she destroyed their expensive high-tech helicopter and left them to find their own way home.
weaknesses: Seems to be afraid of Theresa Rourke Cassidy

highsmith.name: Highsmith
highsmith.origin: Highsmith (whose first name is unknown) discovered she was a mutant at a relatively young age, when her parents suspected she needed plastic surgery. When she grew up, she became one of the settlers at a mutant "Utopia" in Antarctica, where she quarreled with Butterfly-Bore. Unfortunately, the colonists became among the first victims of the insanity-causing abomination Golgotha. Highsmith was comparatively lucky in that she was driven neither homicidal nor suicidal by the beast, but she was still left in a catatonic state, in which she was found by the X-Men. Rogue touched her in an attempt to access her memories to find out what had caused the catastrophe, but she was unsuccessful.
powers: Unrevealed

Highsmith was comparatively lucky in that she was driven neither homicidal nor suicidal by the beast, but she was still left in a catatonic state, in which she was found by the X-Men. Rogue touched her in an attempt to access her memories to find out what had caused the catastrophe, but she was unsuccessful.

highwalker.name: Highwalker
highwalker.origin: Like all peculiar babies in the ancient times, the mutant who would come to be known by the moniker Highwalker had been born enfeebled, a condition which left him mute and quadriplegic in his early years. Because of this he was cast out to die by his own family and tribe when they left him in the vulture hunting grounds known as the "Burnt Place"; a mysteriously scorched earth that never replenishes in which a great many of the fearful primitive humans leave their unwanted kin to fend for themselves. While a physical invalid, the nameless individual's mind was far more advanced than that of his kin; a trait begotten from his differentiation at birth. Through which, he used his vast mental acuity and other special talents to survive out in the wilderness, eventually eking out a feasible life for himself in his youth but eventually coming back every now and then to where he was once abandoned to take in others like him and build a new tribe while coming of age. Whilst observing an orphan girl of wild fire red hair, he came upon the urchin on a return trip to his old crib where the mutant leader would intervene as the latter hovered over a cyclopean infant left where he was once cast aside like so many others, in presenting himself to the youthful child she ran for cover as he carried off the newborn with him back to his little community. It wasn't long after that when the feral waif whom he'd happened across eventually followed him to his cave. Seeking the answers she often inquired about while foraging with her pack of wolves. After meeting face to face with his future ward, The Highwalker would explain to her who he is and where it was Firehair currently found herself situated at. Apologizing in advance for his psychic intrusion and again for not being there for her when her own tribe left her at the Burnt Place the first time around. Being too afraid to confront her callouses clansmen at the time, vowing to never again leave another of their kind to the fetid mercies of the unjust world they lived in. After offering her a place in his humble abode, the red haired stripling would leave her adoptive clan to integrate with that of her new caretaker. Whom was overjoyed to accept her as new blood. Someone whom he could teach to control what she was like he had with many others. Such jovial times would not last however. As the various Neanderthal groups whom had left their deformed young in the vultures roost eventually grew incensed to find what was an enclave of monsters in their midst. Having come armed with rocks & spears to do away with them properly, being the gentle soul that he was; The Highwalker refrained from using violence against his assailants and peaceably withheld their weapons using psychic power. But he would be distracted by the psionic awakening of his newest charge at the most inopportune times. His disrupted focus would cost him his life as a couple of spears penetrated his defenses, killing him. In a retaliatory advance the mutant tribesmen under his care turned back and went on the warpath against their persecutors in revenge for their fallen protector/teacher. Neither side of the conflict survived, save for the damaged and distraught Firehair whose guilt over what became of her newfound people due to her burgeoning ability manifestation waylaying the closest thing to what she would call a father and a friend.

fields.personality: The Highwalker held great empathy for all life, be it cro-magnon or early mutant. Often taking in estranged infants amongst other peoples whom were left to die in the burnt place to care for them as his own. He was an advanced mind for his age possessing a psychological intuitive nature and charisma that enabled him to keep the peace with the scores of the superpowered cavemen whom looked to him for guidance. Such was his gentle nature that he would not raise a hand towards those whom had come in anger with ill intent on their minds.
fields.additional_attributes: Quadriplegia: Due to either malnutrition or physical illness that was prominent at birth, quite possibly a combination of both. The Highwalker was born and grew up to by physically frail early on in life. Having been unable to support his own body with said feeble arms and legs since infancy.

hijacker mercenary.name: Hijacker (Mercenary)
hijacker mercenary.origin: Using nanites bought from Overdrive, this person took the mantle of Hijacker, and became a mercenary. He was one of the numerous henchmen available through Power Broker's Hench App. His first job came when the Miami crimelord Slug hired him through the app in order to steal a Giganto egg from a S.H.I.E.L.D. cargo ship. When he was taking control of the vessel, he was stopped by Captain America and Ant-Man, and he was subsequently knocked out by the former.

hijiro nguri.name: Hijiro Nguri
hijiro nguri.origin: In 1885, the American, Canadian, Russian, and Japanese governments and various private businessmen all began vying to locate and control a mountain filled with above-ground crude oil in Alaska, so much easily accessible oil that whoever held it could easily dominate the world economy. Hijiro Nguri was sent to Alaska as an agent for the Japanese government in order to locate this mountain, but he turned against his clan as he regarded Japan's participation in the bloody oil conspiracy to be dishonorable. Nguri went on to join fugitives Two-Gun Kid, Marcel Fournier and the Apache warrior Running Fish to locate the oil mountain and destroy it. The quartet succeeded in this, blowing up the mountain. Seemingly killed, the group actually survived the blast and remained together for a time as the Sunset Riders. The group soon drifted apart, however, and Nguri was later said to have dropped out of sight in San Francisco. His subsequent activities are unknown. Nguri's ultimate fate is unknown but, during the War of the Realms in modern day, his spirit was called by the Demon Rider, the Sorcerer Supreme from the 1800s. The Demon Rider had been summoned by Thor's sister Laussa for protection while evading he forces of the Queen of Cinders. To this end, the Demon Rider called the ghosts of Hijiro Nguri and other heroes from their time. The spirits encountered Laussa's protectors, her "Babysitters Club," in the Wild West-themed amusement park Six Gun Territory. A fight broke out since the spirits couldn't properly communicate their intention, until Druid's magic allowed him to understand that Laussa was the reason for their presence. After the Demon Rider made herself present and clarified that the undead warriors intended to pledge their allegiance to Laussa, they all rode out of the town to take part in the War of the Realm's final battle.
abilities: Hijiro Nguri is an expert swordsman, having been trained in the ancient arts of the samurai warrior.
weapons: Two katana swords

hikaru akatsuki.name: Hikaru Akatsuki
hikaru akatsuki.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 1
hikaru akatsuki.origin: Hikaru is the oldest son of Dr. Nozomu Akatsuki. In contrast to his brother Akira, he is more calm, quiet, and mature. He has many talents, like being a good student, sportsman, and gamer. He has skipped several grades and is thus already in university. His one flaw however is that he tends to be overly concerned about Akira, and often forgets everything else around him if Akira is in trouble. Hikaru and his brother Akira were left in the care of their Aunt since their father had to go to America to work on his latest project: the DISK. Since Tony Stark wanted Akira and Hikaru to be proud of their father, he allowed both boys to attend the official presentation of the DISKs at the Raft. However, since Akira stopped on his way home to help a young boy find his mother, the two of them missed their flight to America. Fortunately, Tony Stark sends Pepper Potts with his private jet to pick the boys up. During the demonstration, Loki and his henchmen, the Celebrity Five, crashed the party by releasing all super-villains from their cells and DISKs. While the Avengers tried to fight off the horde of villains, Dr. Akatsuki and his 2 sons found themselves cornered in the lab by Crimson Dynamo, who wanted the last Biocode Installer. Thanks to interference from Spider-Man, the villain was defeated, but Dr. Akatsuki was wounded in the process. Therefore, he gave Akira the suitcase with the installer and ordered both him and Hikaru to follow Spider-Man to the heliport. Along the way, the boys ran into 3 other kids: Chris, Jessica, and Ed. When the group noticed King Cobra, who had taken Pepper Potts, hostage, Hikaru participated in Akira's plan to free her. Akira approached King Cobra and offered to trade the installer for Pepper, but in doing so he lured King Cobra towards some containers, which the others then pushed on top of him. By then, Loki had already captured four of the Avengers, leaving only Iron Man to continue the fight until he too was captured. When M.O.D.O.K. tried to destroy the biocode installer, the installer instead gave Hikaru and the other four kids a Biocode. Not much later, a scuffle between Akira and Loki created a shockwave that scattered all DISKs containing the heroes and villains across the globe, robbing Loki of his army. In the aftermath, Akira and Hikaru were both taken into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and learned that their biocodes were incomplete. As a result, they could only temporarily release the trapped heroes from the DISKs. They also learned that their father had gone missing. When Loki, in his guise of Senator Robert, put S.H.I.E.L.D. out of action, Akira and Hikaru teamed up with Pepper Potts and Hawkeye to find the other DISKs before Loki could do so. Hikaru was a little more reluctant than Akira to leap into action but was convinced to do the right thing by Hawkeye. Hikaru then received Thor's disk from Spider-Man, and became the partner of the Asgardian god. Together, they recruited Chris as their ally and stopped the Hulk when the latter was mind-controlled by Diablo into attacking an Air Force Base. With 4 of the five Avengers back on their side, they attacked the ship of the Celebrity Five to free Jessica and Ed, and secure Wasp's DISK, thus completing their team. While on a mission to an abandoned research facility to secure a lost DISK, a plot by Loki to lure Thor away from the others made Hikaru realize how carried away he tends to get if Akira is concerned. He managed to make Thor see reason and promised Akira to be more mindful from now on. When Tony Stark enrolled Hikaru and his friends in Techno Isle international school, Hikaru began a relationship with a girl named Noriko Ashida, only to discover that she was a mutant. He tried to help her come to terms with this, and coerce her into using her powers to free the Avengers from their DISKs. Although this last plan failed, he did succeed in making Noriko accept who she was. The two of them had to say goodbye when she went to America with the other X-Men. During the battle with Loki in the latters Ice Palace, Hikaru managed to synchronize his biocode with his partner, thus giving Thor the ability to draw power from him and extend his time limit. When Red Skull started his plan to destroy the world and the Avengers had to split up to take out his 5 bases of operation, Hikaru and Thor were tasked with taking out the base guarded by Graviton. Just like their fellow Avengers, they succeeded in their mission and thus thwarted Red Skull's plan. However, Red Skull still had a trick up his sleeve; immediately after the battle, he confronted Hikaru and stated his alternative plan to plunge the world into despair, starting by targeting Akira. Just like Red Skull planned, Hikaru's desire to protect his little brother caused him to panic, and in desperation the teen absorbed a shard of the Dimension Sphere from the recently destroyed Gaia Anchor into his body, hoping it would help him defend Akira. Instead, the Sphere's dark energy made

hilda boone.origin: Hilda Boone was an Atlantean who lived on Earth. Along with four other Atlanteans, he took advantage of the opportunity offered to him by a television program to be able to dive deep into the ocean to return to Atlantis. hilda von hate.name: Hilda von Hate
hilda von hate.origin: Hilda von Hate, She-Witch of the S.S. was a witch who worked for the Nazis. She managed to escape from Major Dakor in 1945 through a dimensional rift. By 1947 she had set up a new base on the Caribbean island of Tani where she began to amass a zombie army using magic siphoned from Erida, the Goddess of Hatred. She was confronted by the Department of the Uncanny and the Invaders where she died. Her death left a portal open that allowed Erida to eventually enter the real world in the modern age. Von Hate apparently had at least one child, as her descendant Heinrich von Hate continued the family traditions of both witchcraft and Nazism.

hippothoe.name: Hippothoè
hippothoe.origin: Hippothoè was one of the Amazons living in Themiscyra, on the Thermodon River, in Anatolia. Along with eleven other fellow Amazons Clonié, Polemusa, Evandrè, Antandrè, Bremusa, Derinoè , Harmothoè, Alcibiè, Derimacheia, Antibrotè and Thermodosa, Clonié accompanied Penthesilea who went to Troy in the last years of the Trojan War in order to cleanse her soul after the accidental murder of her sister and queen Hippolyta. The Amazons were acclaimed by the crowd and welcomed by King Priam and his family. There, Penthesilea swore that she and her Amazons would kill Achilles and repel the Argives back to their coasts, despite the accusation of arrogance from Andromache, widow of Hector whom Achilles had slain. The next day, they went to battle as the vanguard of the Trojans who were galvanized by Penthesilea. Priam prayed for help to Zeus, but saw an eagle grasping a dove and interpreted it as the fact Penthesileia would not return alive. Thersites alarmed the Argives, and they met the Trojans in the battlefield. There, Hippothoè was killed along all her sword-sisters. Witnessing the death of her Amazons, Penthesilea entered a fury, and was herself eventually killed by Achilles. Hippothoè and the other Amazons were buried beside Penthesilea.
weapons: Sword and/or spear.

hiram cragmoor.name: Hiram Cragmoor
hiram cragmoor.origin: Hiram Cragmoor was an enigmatic recluse who had been bound to a giant ruby, serving as an agent of Fate responsible for escorting recently deceased souls to the afterlife. His instructions came from the "Greater Realm," dictating how and where the departed should be guided. When reporter Mike Mathews trespassed into his mansion, Cragmoor exploited the opportunity to transfer his duties, imprisoning Mathews inside the ruby and regaining his freedom. Afterward, he reportedly recounted the events to Stan Lee at Marvel Comics, who dismissed the tale, leaving Cragmoor satisfied that his secret remained hidden as he departed from the mortal plane.

hiram johnson.name: Hiram Johnson
hiram johnson.origin: Mine owner Hiram Johnson runs the most profitable mine in the region, casting aside all qualms of worker safety and skirting regulations in the name of profits. Despite his plans to groom his son, Charlie, to take his place, Charlie is dismayed with his father's reckless behavior and callous attitude. After the miners protest outside the Johnson home, Charlie leaves the mansion and moves in to the slum town the mine workers call home, beginning to work in the mines. Tracking Charlie down, Hiram demands Charlie return home, but Charlie disowns his father, predicting that his blind greed will lead him to ruin, and refuses to leave. Disheartened, Hiram returns home, but convinces himself Charlie will return once he experiences the terrible conditions the miners live in. However, the next day, an explosion rips through the mines, trapping dozens of workers below ground. Unphased by the all-to-common scene, Hiram impatiently waits for the casualties to clear out so the mine can return to operation. However, he overhears two of the mine foremen commenting that two workers, Larkin and Johnson, are still trapped below. Climbing into the crumbled mine shaft, Hiram finds that the Johnson trapped in the rumble is in fact his son. As Hiram pulls his lifeless son's body from the rumble, he laments on his son's predictions.

hiram swenson.name: Hiram Swenson
hiram swenson.origin: Hiram Swenson was a Norwegian anthropologist who disappeared in the Himalayas after allegedly being beaten and left for dead by Sherpas. Rescued by a hidden tribe of Snowmen, he chose to remain among them, becoming convinced they were descendants of Cro-Magnon humans who had lived in isolation for thousands of years. Over time, his desire to protect the tribe from the outside world developed into an obsession, and he assumed a position of authority within their society. When Man-Thing and Elaine Simpson were brought to the hidden valley, Swenson viewed them as a threat to the tribe's survival. Despite explaining the Snowmen's history to Elaine, he ordered both captives imprisoned and later prepared to execute them. His plans were interrupted when Roger Grafton and an armed expedition attacked the settlement. Swenson was apparently killed by gunfire during the assault, ending his self-appointed mission to preserve the hidden civilization.

hiro cyburai.name: Hiro (Cyburai)
hiro cyburai.origin: Hiro was a cybernetically enhanced warrior and a member of the Tatsu Clan, serving as one of the principal lieutenants of the Japanese crime lord Tatsu'o. He was also a cousin of Opal Tanaka, whom he was ordered to bring back to Japan after her grandfather discovered her existence. Although he initially supported Tatsu'o's plan to secure a blood heir through Opal's marriage to one of his warriors, Hiro gradually began questioning his master's methods and his own identity. He had once dreamed of becoming a poet, but chose to follow his family's criminal traditions, aspiring to become a dangerous warrior who nevertheless upheld the honor of a samurai. His extensive cybernetic modifications, however, increasingly made him doubt whether he still possessed genuine freedom of choice. When Opal openly defied her grandfather, Hiro attempted to explain the circumstances surrounding her parents' relationship and the sacrifices her mother had made to protect her from the Yakuza. Despite his growing sympathy for Opal, he remained loyal to Tatsu'o. During the ensuing confrontation between the Tatsu Clan and the forces of Mariko Yashida, Hiro fought against Iceman but refused to strike him from behind, considering such an act dishonorable. His reluctance to kill his opponent angered his fellow oyabun, Ko'ichi and Toshi, who subsequently turned against him. Iceman intervened when the two attempted to kill Hiro, but Hiro insisted that he still had to fight him because of his allegiance to Tatsu'o. Their confrontation eventually ended when Hiro, unable to reconcile his sense of honor with his cybernetic nature, deliberately refused to continue fighting. Later, Hiro traveled to the United States at the request of Madame Tatsu'o in one final attempt to preserve his family's honor. He located Iceman and Opal while they were dining with Bobby's parents, William and Maddy Drake, and warned them that their lives were in danger. Shortly afterward, six cybernetically enhanced warriors known as the Cyburai attacked the restaurant, intending to kill the Drakes in retaliation for Iceman's interference in the Tatsu Clan's affairs. Hiro joined Iceman in fighting the attackers and protected Opal when one of the Cyburai attempted to seize her. Realizing that he and Iceman could not defeat their opponents, Hiro urged Opal to leave with Bobby and live happily, confessing his love for her. He then remained behind to confront the Cyburai, activating his self-destruct program as they surrounded him. The resulting explosion destroyed the restaurant and apparently killed Hiro along with the attacking warriors.

On the road he was found by Dr. Mallarkey. ===M-Day and Civil War=== It is unknown if Base kept his powers after M-Day. Base was one of the foreign costumed hero suggested for monitoring by Tony Stark.

hirohito.name: Hirohito
hirohito.origin: ===Preface=== Hirohito (1901-1989) is based on the real life wartime emperor of Imperial Japan. Presumably, the fictional character's history is mostly the same as his real life counterpart. The scope of this article is to cover the activities of the fictional character and his interactions in the Earth-616 universe. For a full history of the real life Hirohito, consult . Further, as it has been revealed that a number of wartime adventures were fictional accounts of actual events, some of the appearances listed below are as accurate as their depiction in Timely Comics publications. In addition to the slanted propaganda of these publications, a number of appearances by Hirohito may have been the work of impersonators as, much like Hitler, Hirohito employed actors to pose as him in public. ===World War II=== In his first recorded appearance, during the summer of 1942, Hirohito paid a visit to Nazi Germany on to meet with Adolf Hitler and Benito Mussolini to discuss the progress of the war. Their meeting was interrupted by an attack by the Victory Boys who came to rescue their teammate Maxie Stein who was captured by Nazi forces. Hirohito was insulted by the boys, who called him "Little Hitler" before fleeing into the night. In 1943, Hirohito personally deployed the Serpent to eliminate Ling Toy, a Chinese-American who learned that the Japanese had dug a tunnel from Japan to the United States. However, the Young Allies got involved, clashing personally with Hirohito, delivering the emperor a humiliating defeat before destroying the tunnel. Later that year, Hirohito joined his Axis allies Hitler and Mussolini to accept an offer from the mad scientist known as the Torso to eliminate Captain America and Bucky. Although Hirohito and the others agreed to fund the Torso's plan, it ultimately failed. Hirohito faced another humiliating defeat at the hands of the Young Allies, when the group of youths once more found themselves prisoners of the Japanese. Hirohito's agent the Whip was torturing the Allies to learn the location to some stolen plans, when Toro freed his pals and knocked Hirohito into the torture device -- a mixture of the iron maiden and the electric chair. Given a powerful jolt of electricity, Hirohito exclaimed his deepest doubts about their victory over the American's before being pulled out. The Whip attempted to recapture the Young Allies, but they escaped, prompting the Whip to commit suicide for his failure. Later still, Hirohito sanctioned his agent Yoko to use a submarine decoyed to look like an American freighter in order to attack convoys unnoticed. This plan was ruined by the Sub-Mariner. In his last recorded appearance, circa 1944, Hirohito answered a call to bid on a meteor fragment that could be harnessed as a powerful weapon. He sent some of his agents to bid on the item; however, it was ultimately destroyed by Captain America and Bucky. ===Death=== In real life, unlike many others involved in the War, Hirohito avoided war crime persecution and continued to rule as Japanese emperor until his death in 1989. If this is same fate shared by his Earth-616 counterpart remains to be seen. In more recent times (in what can be considered a topical reference), Hirohito was still active as His Imperial Majesty, Emperor of Japan, and his name was included in the invitation for the wedding of Mariko Yashida with Logan. In an excerpt from her biography of Doctor Stephen Strange that was published in the November 1989 issue of Now Magazine, author Morgana Blessing wrote of Doctor Strange's funeral and referenced how the Japanese emperor Hirohito had "died soon afterward." This is also a topical reference since, due to the Sliding Timescale, the "Secret Wars" during which Strange was supposedly killed by the Beyonder is now considered to have taken place decades after 1989.

hiroshi murata.name: Hiroshi Murata
hiroshi murata.origin: Hiroshi Murata was a Yakuza Oyabun. He ordered ninja to eliminate Kanaye Nakadai's family in exchange for information about a powerful weapon known to Kanaye's father. After the confusion following the murder of Kenichi Nakadai, Murata tried to eliminate Kanaye himself to eliminate all evidence using the same weapons, namely technologically advanced WWII robots. His plan was opposed by Logan, a longtime friend of Kinichi, who initially protected Kanaye but when he learned of what he had done, he made the robots hit the place where both Hiroshi and Kanaye were, killing them both.

hiroshi yamashiro.name: Hiroshi Yamashiro
hiroshi yamashiro.origin: Hiroshi Yamashiro was an astrophysicist who began to notice an increased alien presence attempting to invade Earth but didn't know the identity. He and his daughter Shinko witnessed the arrival of Marviller to earth. The invading force was Professor Monster and they set out to kill the professor to prevent him from using the power of Marviller to defeat them. To this end, Amazoness posed as the editor to Hitomi Sakuma and asked her to get in contact with the professor and investigate the Marviller. Hiroshi, Shinko and Hitomi traveled to the crash site of the Marviller and were attacked by Boukunryu. Hiroshi was fatally injured and was found by his son, Takuya and with his dying words, asked Takuya to stop the invaders.

his little hugeness.name: His Little Hugeness
his little hugeness.origin: When Steve Harmon ended up in the realm of the Dimension X, the resident Scientist Supreme (who resembled Groucho Marx) helped him master his new form, a body composed of living unstable molecules dubbed Electroplasm. This essentially made him a living cartoon character. The scientist, who had been ousted from his position by the Overlord, theorized that Steve had come to his new form because he was slightly out of synch when entering the fun-house portal. Using his new powers and a map the scientist had, Steve freed many captive Earthlings from the evil Clowns from Dimension X and their ruler, the Overlord. It was learned that this was what the scientist had intended all long. The Overlord's plan had been to brainwash Earthlings enough so their belief would be sufficient to give Overlord whatever he desired. The Overlord's plans were foiled when the belief that held up his castle gave way as the humans regained their right minds. The castle crashed. The captured humans ran to the portal, followed quickly by the monstrous clowns. Steve destroyed the mirror, eradicating the clown's influence on this reality. Minutes afterward, Steve was found by his best friend, who agreed to assist him.

hisako ichiki moira ii 4.name: Hisako Ichiki (Moira-II.4)
hisako ichiki moira ii 4.origin: In a temporal offshoot of Earth-616 designated as Moira-II.4, Abigail Brand successfully saw her plan to start an intergalactic war to completion. However she underestimated and was betrayed by Orbis Stellaris, whose army simultaneously struck Arakko, Krakoa, and Earth as a whole. Unprepared, most Avengers perished in the opening salvo, which killed most people on Earth and made the planet uninhabitable by stripping its atmosphere. A small group of Mutants survived by escaping to space on an Acanti-borne Arakko, ironically under the leadership of Brand herself. Allying with the Starjammers, Brand's X-Men survived for years, occasionally making supply runs to Earth's airless surface. During one such run they rescued and brought with them a group of their long-dead friends - time-traveling X-Men from another timeline. Prodigy's power allowed him to absorb Brand's memory and quickly bring his group up to speed on her timeline's history. Armor asked whether they came to fix their situation, but Frenzy replied that they shouldn't be even talking for fear of creating paradoxes. Time-traveling X-Men asked to be brought back to the surface when the Technarchy attacked, send by Stellaris who was after the last mysterium in the universe that was kept by Brand's X-Men. They engaged the intruders in a fight, in which the Starjammers soon arrived to help, while the time-traveling X-Men proceeded with their own mission.

hjarmal svenson.name: Hjarmal Svenson
hjarmal svenson.origin: Doctor Svenson was doing research on respiration in arctic regions, while he was kidnapped by the Kallusians to help them breathe the Earth's oxygen. As a scientist, he was vastly interested in helping them, and after many experiments he succeeded in producing tiny oxygen granules that enable them to survive. While his identity was replaced by a Kallusian, he stayed in their underground city until he was found by the Avengers, who came to the North Pole looking for him, as his experiments in lung restoration might have been the only chance to save the dying Wasp. When the Kallusians had to flee from their enemies, Dr. Svenson was brought back to America and operated successfully on the Wasp.

hji.name: Hji
hji.origin: Hji is an alien member of the Society of Higher Interstellar Education and Logistical Development (SHIELD), an interplanetary community of scientific researchers and educators operating from the starship Shield Orbiter and in good standing with the Intergalactic Institute of Advanced Learning of the planet Rus. Hji is well prepared in the use of SHIELD's advanced technology. SHIELD discovered about Earth-born superhuman Firebird (Bonita Juarez) and correctly deduced that her superpowers were related to SHIELD activities. Fearing that Firebird may be a threat or a hindrance to other Earthlings, SHIELD abducted her to perform painful experiments on her body so as to take relevant conclusions. Onboard the Orbiter, SHIELD's Prime Theoretician Chlreee led the investigation, with fellow Hji operating a machine that gave them information. When Firebird spoke out loud in English, Chlreee immediately asked Hji whether that was a language to be informed of, and Hji identified it as an Anglo-Saxon variation. Afterward, Hji provided a playback of Firebird's recent past with a Cyberlink Actuate Holopict; but, being those the events just before Firebird's abduction, Chlreee noticed that they had to research into older times. Looking at previous events in which Juarez spoke Spanish (with Hji translating), they discovered the meteor-related origin of Firebird's powers, and Chlreee immediately understood that Yrd Base-Level Pupil Yoof had performed an unauthorized experiment, then carelessly disposed of waste elements by throwing those away, and those same residues had empowered Firebird. Chlreee was visibly angry at Yoof. Firebird then released herself and demanded to know what was happening, attacking the scientists (thou the Orbiter's security measures protected them against immediate harm); Hji immediately wanted to check whether their subject had been damaged in that process. Chlreee ordered to activate the translator for the two used languages, and stepped forward personally to talk with Firebird. Chlreee apologized, explained what was happening, and what had happened, and how they only wanted to ensure that Earth remained stable. Firebird was enraged at discovering that young, irresponsible Yoof had accidentally given her powers, and focused an attack and scolding on him; then had a short crisis of faith. Chlreee, already impressed at how Firebird had used her powers in the encounter, reassured Firebird, telling her of the specifics of her powers and how useful they were, then returned her to Earth.

hobar.name: Hobar
hobar.origin: Hobar was the leader of the hill-men who ambushed Conan's party when was riding with the Turanian army. To end the conflict in an honorable manner, he offered a bargain: a Turanian champion would fight a hill-man to the death at the holy hour of sundown. As the Cimmerian eventually won the duel against the hill-man Toruk, Hobar acknowledged the defeat and allowed the Turanian army to leave in peace. Many years later, Conan, now leading a fighting force including the Free Companions and the Kozaks on the steppes west of Turan, returned to Hobar's territory in search of allies. Conan's forces were suddenly assaulted by the immense magical Hand of Nergal, which decimated them until turning back into mist and vanishing back toward Yaralet. Hobar agreed to ally with the Cimmerian against the Turanian army, and he headed to Yaralet to join forces with Prince Thann.

hobart brown clone.name: Hobart Brown (Clone)
hobart brown clone.origin: After the new Electro Francine Frye almost killed the Prowler during his infiltration into New U Headquarters, the Jackal created a clone of him to work for New U Technologies as a spy within Parker Industries, alleging that he was the original simply brought back to life and convincing him to join his cause. The Jackal had the clone of Prowler become his head of security, with the main task of keeping an eye on the army of deceased supervillains of Spider-Man cloned by the Jackal. When New U's systems suffered numerous hacking attempts, Prowler was tasked with investigating their source. With the help of the cloned Madame Web, the Prowler found the hacker at Alcatraz Island, who turned out to be the new Madame Web and former teammate of Prowler, Julia Carpenter. Once he damaged Carpenter's systems, Prowler tried to convince her to join New U, but she rejected the offer and escaped. Right after collapsing due to the cellular decay that afflicted all of New U's clones, which kicked off due to Hobie having been unable to take the required pill to prevent it, Brown was found by Electro. Francine had been sent by the Jackal to recover the Prowler, however, the bad blood between them prompted her to take a shot at Hobie. In spite of his state of decay, Hobie managed to short circuit Electro and knock her out. Julia returned to Alcatraz island and, shocked by Hobie's state, helped him by bringing him back to San Francisco on a boat. Fortunately due to complications in the Jackal's plans, New U's base was abandoned, which didn't cause Madame Web problems when she brought Prowler back, allowing Brown to take the pills and recover. Julia tried to get him to stay behind while she infiltrated New U's new base at the Transamerica Pyramid, but Hobie ignored her and rejoined the Jackal's crew. By then, Spider-Man had been brought to the base by the Jackal in an attempt to convince him to join his side. When the hero refused, the Jackal had the army of villains attack him, but Prowler jumped into action to help him. Unfortunately, further developments in the Jackal's plans led to an audio frequency that accelerated the decay of the clones being broadcast across New U's base, which put Hobie's life at risk again. Using a sonic dampener built into his suit, the Prowler managed to slow down his decay and help out Spider-Man and some of his allies, namely Jean DeWolff, Spider-Woman and Scarlet Spider, in containing the army of villains, who had gone on a rampage as a consequence of their decay and threatened to devolve into carriers of the lethal Carrion Virus. When his condition worsened to the point he could barely stand, Spider-Woman insisted to leave Hobie hidden in an alley. The Carrion Virus outbreak was stopped by Spider-Man, as well as the clones' break down. However, Electro found Prowler and attempted to kill him. Madame Web, who had infiltrated the base, saved Brown's life, but he had to quickly repay the favor. When Francine began to electrocute Julia, Hobie jumped at her, pinned her to a wall, and punched her. An explosion ensued which knocked down Electro and fatally injured Hobie. Prowler collapsed on the ground and died in Julia's arms, dissolving afterwards. Following the Jackal's fall, his former associate Dr. Rita Clarkson directed Spider-Man and his allies to a sub-basement where New U kept in stasis all of their patients who had clones made of them, some of them whose conditions, afflictions or diseases had been cured with New U's procedures. One of these individuals was the real Hobie Brown. Soon after waking up, Hobie was informed about his deceased clone by Madame Web. When Hobie asked what was he like, Julia replied he had been good.
weaknesses: Pill Dependence: In order to avoid cellular degradation, Hobie has to ingest New U Pills daily.

hobart zemo.name: Hobart Zemo
hobart zemo.first_appearance: Thunderbolts Presents: Zemo - Born Better Vol 1 3
hobart zemo.origin: Hobart is the tenth Baron in the Zemo family lineage. Hobart was killed during a civilian uprising in 1879. After attempts were made on the life of the German emperor, William I, the previous year, there was legislation passed that outlawed the social democratic party which led to the uprising. Hobart's great-grandson from the future, Helmut Zemo, had tried to save his life, but went back in time before being able to do so. After Hobart's death the Barony fell to his son Baron Herman Zemo.

hocky hoof hank.name: Hocky Hoof Hank
hocky hoof hank.origin: Hocky Hoof Hank was a horse with the powers of Thor. When Squirrel Girl got into a fight with the Silver Surfer over a misunderstanding, Loki summoned several beings to her aid. Immediately after teleporting Beta Ray Bill, describing him as "the Thor that looks kinda like a horse," Loki summoned Hocky Hoof Hank, "the Thor that's literally an actual horse." The Silver Surfer swiftly dealt with Squirrel Girl's reinforcements, and slapped them so hard he knocked all of them back to the planets that they had come from, including Hocky Hoof Hank.

hog zilla.name: Hog-zilla
hog zilla.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 8
hog zilla.origin: Hog-zilla was a Tyrannoswinus rex ("king of the tyrant pigs") who for some reason had not died when its (his? her?) species became extinct millions of years in the past. Active underwater in the coast of Japan in the present day, Hog-zilla caused an increased seismic activity that attracted attention of the news and of maritime explorer Jacques Gooseteau - who discovered the monster, but was too scared to act. The news also attracted the Daily Beagle staff, including photographer Peter Porker - secretly the superhero Spider-Ham - who was sick with a cold at that time. thumb|left Hog-zilla eventually emerged and attacked Tokyo, apparently wanting to get wasted by eating fast food in the restaurants. The Japanese sent the army under General Llamamotto, but Hog-zilla defeated them by oinking atomic fires. Hog-zilla also defeated a giant robot duplicate of him, Mechano-Hog-zilla, that was created by Japanese scientists to confront him. Although it was destroying the city, Hog-zilla became a pop icon, with caps and merchandising in his image and meme jokes. Hog-zilla was finally defeated when Spider-Ham confronted him. As they were both pigs, Hog-zilla approached Spider-Ham in a non-confrontational stance, only to be infected by Spider-Ham's swine flu. Hog-zilla fell sick, unable to move, then was immediately taken by movie director Cur-Asawa, who wanted him as a star of his next movie.

hoh teh.name: Hoh-Teh
hoh teh.origin: Hoh-Teh was the cousin of Pharaoh Ras Hati-Ka who the Minister of State and the wife of the pharaoh thought wanted to appropriate the throne. He too, like all the members of the court, in the delirium due to the fever of the Pharaoh, were confused with people that the Pharaoh knew in his future life, where he imagined that in the future he was the Egyptologist Ted Craven who was studying his own mummy, and Hoh-Teh, in this case, was the psychoanalyst to whom Ted turned to talk to him about his dreams about the Pharaoh and how his appearance had changed until it was identical to that of the Pharaoh. Hoh-Teh, however, did not intend to take the throne of Hati-Ka, but it was he who recovered the Pharaoh from the fever by telling him that his delirium was due to the fact that he had been very ill.

When Luther Robinson and Lynne Harris launched an attack on Atlantis in retaliation for the Sub-Mariner's attack on New York City, Hola was one of the soldiers who took them prisoner. weaknesses: Like most of people of his kind, Hola can only survive above wate for only a few minutes.

holden blevins.name: Holden Blevins
holden blevins.origin: Holden is a vengeful spirit who seeks to get rid of entities who harm kids. The Unborn Son of Caufeld Blevins, they were somehow trapped in Icebox Bob's dimension. She used a #7 nail file from her purse and stabbed Bob which allowed them to escape. After returning she had a mental break and was placed in an asylum. She eventually ended her own life. But the soul of her child lived on. He contacted Ghost Rider for help and he told him to talk to Johnny Blaze. They - Holden and Blaze - went on a mission to rescue Blaze's children.

holden crane.name: Holden Crane
holden crane.origin: Holden Crane was a student, who was against what American society used to be and what it had become in his time. Holden was travelling on a bus through the Everglades when drunk driver Ralph Sorrell crashed into the bus. Everyone on the bus was killed except Holden, Mary Brown, Jim Arsdale, and the seriously-injured Kevin Kennerman. The survivors teamed up into a group. The group began to move through the swamp, in an attempt to get medical attention for Kevin. Holden was constantly in conflict with Jim, due to their different views on society. Jim nearly beat Holden to death, before being stopped by Mary. When the group approached a settlement, Ralph turned on them. He did not want to be arrested for his role in the accident and had decided to eliminate the witnesses. He killed Holden first.
